title: Buyer
description:
**Job Description**

**WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN US**




 Are you passionate about procurement, supplier collaboration and driving operational excellence? As a Buyer within our team, you’ll play a key role in securing timely and high-quality deliveries of Window Campaigns and printed materials that drive traffic to our stores, increase sales and strengthen our amazing Brand! If you're a skilled negotiator, a problem solver and a relationship builder - this is your chance to turn operational excellence into real business impact.
   

  





**WHAT YOU’LL DO**




 In this role, you’ll manage the end-to-end procurement process with a focus on operational and tactical buying. You’ll work closely with Product Developers, Buyers, Category Buyers, Supply Planners as well as suppliers, internal stakeholders within Marketing, and local teams to ensure that our supply chain runs smoothly and, in a context, where we seek constant opportunities to create magic campaigns and activations.
   

  





 As a Buyer in our team, you will have responsibility over several suppliers, working strategically to develop our supplier base throughout the SRM Process.
   

  





 Your responsibilities include:
   

  




* Run Campaigns and activations within a cross-functional team. Taking full ownership of the procurement part in Campaign Management.
* Manage contract setup, order placement, delivery follow-up, and issue resolution.
* Conduct tactical negotiations for material purchases. Ensure compliance with contractual terms.
* Monitoring supplier capacity and resolving delivery issues across markets.
* Maintain accurate process and documentation of procurement activities.
* Ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
* Develop the supplier base, SRM and SPM. Tracking and evaluating supplier performance, implementing corrective actions when needed. Responsibility of Supplier admin connected to dedicated suppliers and SRM process.
* Identifying opportunities for process improvements, cost saving initiatives and contributing to best practices.
* Analysis of spend data and market analysis as part of the Category work.



**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**




 You’ll be part of a dynamic and collaborative team, working closely with other Buyers, Category Buyer, Product Developers, and our Supply Planner. Our closest stakeholders and collaborative partners are Window Creators, Project Managers, and Production Leads. Other important stakeholders are our Suppliers and Non- commercial goods specialists in our Sales markets. Together, we ensure that our Campaign & Print operations support the business in delivering Traffic, Sales and Brand.
   

  

  

  





**WHO YOU ARE**




 To succeed in this role, we believe you are an experienced buyer with a passion for delivering results and seeing the creative visions come to life within a short timeline. You have an inner drive to constantly find opportunities and solutions and your friendly personality act as a role model for others. You can shift between strategic thinking and analysis to executing activations within tight time-plans without compromising on critical quality and compliance. You are a team player, striving to understand the full End-to-End process to make constant improvements. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, are a trustworthy relationship builder and enjoy working with both data and people.
   

  





 We also see that you have:
   

  




* A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management or a related field.
* 5 years of experience in procurement or supply chain, including 2+ years in operational buying and 2+ year in tactical sourcing. Experience from Strategic Sourcing is considered meritorious.
* Experience from medium to large international companies, preferably with matrix structures.
* Background in indirect spend categories such as consultancy services, facility management or marketing.
* Strong negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to manage supplier relationships and regional coordination.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
* Proficiency in procurement systems (e.g. SAP Ariba, GEP, Coupa) and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.



**WHO WE ARE**




 H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
   

  





 We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.
   

  





  

  





**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**




 At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.
   

  





**An example of our benefits:** 
  

  




* 25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands, both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).
* H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Learn more about the program here.



  

  





**JOIN US**




 Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.
   

  





 Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

title: IT-Tekniker Muskö

 Försvarsmakten befinner sig i en expansionsfas och på en omfattande tillväxtresa. Vill du jobba med tekniken som aldrig får stanna och vara med och säkra Försvarsmaktens förmåga att kommunicera och leda? Låter detta som någonting för dig? Läs vidare!
   

  

 Försvarsmakten söker nu en IT-Tekniker med placering på Muskö.
   

  

**Om Tjänsten**
 Som IT-Tekniker i Försvarsmakten och FMTIS utgör du en viktig del i ett framgångsrikt team, i en myndighet som är i stark tillväxt. Tillsammans med kompetenta och engagerade kollegor får du ansvar, utveckling och utmaning. Allt detta hos en arbetsgivare som uppmuntrar till balans i livet och god hälsa. Du ges bland annat möjlighet att träna på arbetstid, generösa arbetstidsavtal, föräldralön samt upp till sju veckor semester per år.
   

  

 Arbetet är omväxlande och utförs i huvudsak i Försvarsmaktens lokaler på Muskö och till viss del på andra platser i Haninge, men även övriga delar av landet kan förekomma.
   

  

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**

Du kommer jobba med användarstöd på datorer och system i såväl öppen som hemlig IT-miljö. Det kommer även förekomma viss hantering av nätverkskomponenter. Arbetet är till stor del ärendestyrt och innehåller en stor del kontakt med användare.

title: Business Operations Associate
description:
**About Us:** 
 At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.
   

  

**Role Overview:** 
 We began by taking hotel bookings online over 20 years ago and we've been shaping the travel industry ever since. Today, we're building a platform that connects all parts of the trip – from accommodation to transport, flights, tickets, tours and much more!
   

  

 Our Trips Business Unit helps people get where they want to go, anywhere in the world. Whether customers want the freedom of a car, the convenience of a flight, the ease of a taxi or the economy of public transport, we make it all possible.
   

  

 Our team is passionate about helping people travel. They see challenges as opportunities. And they're always ready for change.
   

  

 A trip usually starts with a flight. The Flights team's mission is to offer a wide selection of flights, great value for money and the easiest end-to-end booking experience. We partner with our Strategic partner Etraveli Group to make our mission a reality and have ambitious goals over the next years.
   

  

 The Flights Business Operations Associate is primarily responsible for implementing the necessary processes and structure to ensure the department achieves its goals and operates smoothly, effectively, and efficiently.
   

  

 This role involves supporting the execution of day-to-day operations and establishing an effective "rhythm of business" between the Flights Team and our Strategic Partners.
   

  

 You will support all partner facing business operations activities (such as planning, QBRs), and implement and optimize processes for scaling the partnership, aid in measuring and reporting health and performance for business reviews and drive solutions to medium complexity problems in partnership with involved parties
   

  

 The role will report to the Strategic Partnership Operations Manager and be based in a small team in our Stockholm office.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Identify and drive the set-up, kick-off and execution of new/improved business as usual processes between B.com Flights, internal stakeholders and our Strategic Partner
* Support all partner facing activities with our strategic partner
* Own the collection, analysis and action plan for partnership health topics
* Drive process improvements
* Drive change management within the Flights department to adopt new processes and ways of working
* Run medium complexity projects and initiatives related to our Strategic Partner


**Who you are:**
* You have strong operational skills
* You have experience of building and optimising business processes
* You have project management skills
* You are a fast learner
* You have excellent stakeholder management skills
* You are proactive and able to identify process improvements opportunities

title: Growth & GTM Intern
description:
Company Description
 



  





 Stace is an AI study companion helping Swedish university students prepare more effectively for exams. Stace predicts which topics are most likely to appear based on frequency analysis of past exams, offers AI-coached oral flashcards for spoken practice, and answers questions with citations pulled directly from students' own course materials. We're a small, fast-moving team building practical technology that reduces exam stress and improves outcomes for university students.
 



 Role Description
 



  





 This is a hands-on Go-To-Market internship at an early-stage startup about to soft-launch at Stockholm University. You'll drive on-the-ground student outreach (library visits, campus events, course-specific communities), help build and run our "building in public" presence on LinkedIn, gather and structure user feedback and testimonials from early users, and help test messaging, positioning, and pricing as we learn what resonates. This starts unpaid — we're pre-revenue — with a path to equity if it's a strong fit and Stace gains real traction. Hours are flexible around your studies.
 



 Qualifications
 


* Interest in growth, marketing, or GTM — social media or community experience a plus
* Comfortable with ambiguity; this is early-stage and we're figuring things out together
* Genuinely interested in ed-tech and helping students succeed
* Based in Stockholm (SU/DSV area a plus) or able to work hybrid
* Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a relevant program

title: IT-tekniker vid Must
description:
**Vill du ha ett meningsfullt arbete och bidra till ett säkrare Sverige i en osäker värld?**
 Det förändrade omvärldsläget medför att vårt försvar behöver förstärkas och den ökade underrättelseverksamheten mot Sverige och Försvarsmakten är omfattande. Militära underrättelse- och säkerhetstjänsten (Must) bedriver försvarsunderrättelseverksamhet och militär underrättelse- och säkerhetstjänst till stöd för svensk utrikes-, försvars- och säkerhetspolitik samt i övrigt för kartläggning av yttre hot mot Sverige.
   

  

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**
 Som IT-tekniker hos oss arbetar du i en bred och varierad roll där du ansvarar för både den dagliga driften och den långsiktiga utvecklingen av våra IT-miljöer. Du arbetar med operativ teknik, mobil utrustning för både personal och fordon samt de system och applikationer som verksamheten är beroende av i sitt dagliga arbete. Du arbetar nära verksamheten och slutanvändarna, vilket ställer krav på att du kan omsätta verksamhetens behov till stabila, säkra och effektiva tekniska lösningar. Du kommer att arbeta genom hela IT-infrastrukturen: från nätverk och servrar till klienter, applikationer och operativ teknik samt följa lösningarna genom hela deras livscykel, från installation och konfiguration till drift, underhåll och support.
   

  

 Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:
   

  

* Förvalta, utveckla och optimera befintliga IT-system och tekniska miljöer.
* Ansvara för drift, underhåll och administration av fristående IT-miljöer, inklusive patchning, uppdateringar och serveradministration.
* Installera, konfigurera och implementera hårdvara, klientutrustning och applikationer.
* Felsöka och lösa incidenter inom hårdvara, mjukvara, nätverk och operativ teknik.
* Ge teknisk support och vägledning till verksamhetens användare.
* Delta i införande av nya tekniska lösningar och bidra till utveckling av befintlig infrastruktur.
* Följa den tekniska utvecklingen och aktivt bidra med förbättringsförslag, nya arbetssätt och moderna tekniska lösningar.


 Arbetet är omväxlande och utvecklande i en verksamhet där tekniken ständigt förändras. Därför är kompetensutveckling och omvärldsbevakning en naturlig del av rollen.
   

  

**Om enheten**
 Säkerhetsunderrättelseavdelningen arbetar med att indikera, klarlägga och motverka säkerhetshotande verksamhet samt bedriva försvarsunderrättelseverksamhet kopplat till säkerhetshotande aktörer. Sektionen för teknisk inhämtning ansvarar för teknisk områdesexpertis vid säkerhetsunderrättelseoperationer- och utredningar.
   

  

**Personliga egenskaper**
 Du har ett genuint och djupt intresse för teknik. Du drivs av att förstå hur system fungerar på djupet och nöjer dig inte med att bara få dem att fungera. Ny teknik och komplexa tekniska utmaningar väcker din nyfikenhet och motiverar dig att utveckla dina kunskaper. För dig är lärande en naturlig del av arbetet och du ser förändring som en möjlighet att utvecklas.
   

  

 Du arbetar strukturerat och metodiskt i allt från administration och konfiguration till drift, underhåll och implementation av nya lösningar. Genom ett noggrant arbetssätt säkerställer
   

  

 du kvalitet, stabilitet och säkerhet, även när du hanterar flera uppgifter parallellt eller arbetar i komplexa IT-miljöer.
   

  

 Du är analytisk och tycker om att förstå hur olika system och tekniska komponenter samverkar. Du nöjer dig inte med att lösa ett problem: du vill förstå den bakomliggande orsaken och hur lösningen påverkar helheten. Vid felsökning och problemlösning identifierar du orsaker, ser samband och arbetar systematiskt för att hitta långsiktigt hållbara lösningar.
   

  

 Du är resultatinriktad och motiveras av att lösa tekniska utmaningar. När du ställs inför problem som du inte tidigare har arbetat med använder du din nyfikenhet, kreativitet och uthållighet för att hitta nya angreppssätt och driva arbetet framåt tills en hållbar lösning är på plats. Du ser utmaningar som en möjlighet att utvecklas och tvekar inte inför att ta dig an nya tekniska områden.
   

  

 Du har lätt för att samarbeta och trivs med att arbeta nära både kollegor och verksamheten. Du delar gärna med dig av dina kunskaper, bidrar aktivt till ett gott samarbetsklimat och vill tillsammans med andra utveckla arbetssätt, tekniska lösningar och den gemensamma kompetensen. Arbetets natur ställer samtidigt höga krav på personlig mognad, ansvarstagande och integritet. Du inger förtroende genom ett professionellt förhållningssätt och ett gott omdöme.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
* Minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet inom IT, med serverdrift eller nätverksdrift
* Erfarenhet av automatisering
* Mycket god erfarenhet av Linux
* Erfarenhet inom virtualiseringslösningar
* Erfarenhet med backuplösningar
* Arbete med fristående härdade tekniska miljöer
* B-körkort


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av arbete inom Försvarsmakten
* Erfarenhet av administration av olika typer av databaser
* Arbete med stora dataflöden


 Ovan ställda kvalifikationer ska på begäran kunna verifieras genom intyg, referenser samt arbets- eller urvalstester.
   

  

 Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.
   

  

**Övrigt**
* Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning som inleds med provanställning om sex månader
* Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse
* Arbetsort: Stockholm
* Resor och annan tjänstgöringsort i Mälardalen förekommer. Resor nationellt och internationellt förekommer.


**För upplysningar om befattningen eller rekryteringsprocessen kontakta:**
 hkv-rekrytering-must@mil.se, vänligen skriv ”IT-tekniker” i ämnesraden.
   

  

**Fackliga företrädare**
 Fackliga representanter nås via hkv-rekrytering-must@mil.se
   

  

*Varmt välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-09-15. I ditt CV och personliga brev vill vi att du beskriver på vilket sätt du uppfyller våra efterfrågade krav och meriter. Du ansöker via jobb.forsvarsmakten.se. Löpande urval kan komma att ske.*
 Ansökningar till denna befattning kommer endast tas emot via Försvarsmaktens webbplats.
   

  

 ,
 **Ansökningar till denna befattning kommer endast tas emot via Försvarsmaktens webbplats.** 
 -------------------------------------------------------- Militära underrättelse- och säkerhetstjänsten (Must) är en del av Försvarsmaktens högkvarter i Stockholm. Vi ger regeringen och Försvarsmakten kvalificerade beslutsunderlag om omvärldsutvecklingen och hot mot Sveriges och Försvarsmaktens säkerhet. Vår vision är ”Ett säkrare Sverige i en osäker värld”. Must är en kunskapsorganisation och erbjuder både spännande och för Sverige angelägna arbetsuppgifter. Här arbetar både officerare och civila experter inom olika områden, t ex statsvetenskap, IT, ekonomi, teknik, matematik och HR. En stor del av Must verksamhet omfattas av sekretess och vi ber dig därför att inte berätta att du sökt jobb hos Must för andra personer än dina närmaste. Läs gärna mer om Must och vår verksamhet här Varje dag och varje timme gör våra medarbetare insatser som påverkar andra människors liv, både i stort och smått, och både på hemmaplan och runt om i världen. Försvarsmakten ger dig möjlighet att utvecklas som människa och växa i din professionella roll. Vi är en ansvarstagande arbetsgivare och har en öppen organisation där vi ställer upp för varandra. I Försvarsmakten finns en stark värdegrund som bygger på öppenhet, resultat och ansvar. Professionell utveckling och personlig hälsa värdesätts och uppmuntras. Det finns goda förutsättningar för intern karriärrörlighet, friskvård och bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Försvarsmakten tillvaratar de kvaliteter som mångfald och jämn könsfördelning tillför verksamheten. Vi välkomnar därför sökanden med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter i våra rekryteringar. En anställning hos oss innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Vanligtvis krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning enligt 3 kap i säkerhetsskyddslagen. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. I anställningen ingår även en skyldighet att tjänstgöra utomlands. Innebörden av detta varierar beroende på typ av befattning. Till ansökan om anställning ska CV och personligt brev bifogas. Om du går vidare i anställningsprocessen ska alltid vidimerade kopior av betyg och intyg uppvisas. Samtal från externa rekryteringsföretag och säljare undanbedes.

title: Communications Manager
description:
**Do you want to work with one of the world's most influential brands? On a global company powered by ambitious people with a can-do attitude? Then you might be the person we're looking for.**
 As Communications Manager, your mission is to make people talk about Red Bull.
   

  

 You will develop communication strategies and creative campaigns that turn Red Bull's athletes, events, partnerships and product launches into cultural conversations. Working across Earned, Managed and Owned channels, you'll combine storytelling, creativity and media expertise to build brand love and create ideas that people genuinely want to share.
   

  

 This role has a strong focus on creative brand communications, including new product launches, seasonal editions and consumer campaigns. Working closely with Brand Marketing, you'll help transform business objectives and product launches into communication ideas that activate creators, media, consumers and our own channels.
   

  

 You'll also play an important role in developing communication around our initiatives within sports & fitness, creating integrated campaigns that generate earned attention and inspire audiences.
   

  

 You’ll work cross-functionally with Brand Marketing, Content, Social Media, Events and Sports Marketing, acting as project lead for communication plans that bring Red Bull’s biggest ideas to life.
   

  

 Selection and interviews are ongoing - the last day for applications is the 30th of August.
   

  

 Due to summer holidays, response time may be longer than usual. We will get back as soon as possible and appreciate your patience.
   

  

**All the responsibilities we'll trust you with:**
**CREATIVE BRAND COMMUNICATIONS**
 You believe great communication starts with great ideas. Working closely with Brand Marketing, On-Premise and Off-premise, you'll help develop creative 360 concepts and activations for new product launches, seasonal editions and strategic marketing initiatives. You know how to transform a product launch into something people want to experience, talk about and share. You're constantly looking for unexpected ways to activate creators, media, consumers and social platforms around Red Bull's products and campaigns.
   

  

**CREATING TALKABILITY**
 You have an instinct for what makes people stop scrolling, journalists pick up the phone and creators want to participate. You understand how cultural relevance, creativity and storytelling come together to generate attention. You know how to identify or create the moments that make Red Bull impossible to ignore.
   

  

**STORY DEVELOPMENT**
 You know how to uncover compelling stories that inspire people to live life to the fullest while authentically integrating both brand and product. You translate marketing initiatives into engaging communication concepts across earned, owned and managed channels, always searching for the strongest story angle.
   

  

**PROJECT LEADERSHIP**
 You'll act as the communication lead across multiple projects, coordinating stakeholders from idea through execution. Working closely with experts across Content, Social Media, Brand Marketing, Sports Marketing and Events, you'll build communication plans that are clear, ambitious and measurable. You establish key milestones, manage timelines and ensure communication remains aligned across every touchpoint.
   

  

**MEDIA & CREATOR PARTNERSHIPS**
 Relationships matter. You'll build and maintain strong partnerships with journalists, creators, production partners and media companies to maximize the impact of Red Bull's initiatives. You understand how earned media, creator collaborations and social-first content work together to create stronger communication than any single channel can achieve on its own. You'll also monitor communication performance and continuously optimize plans based on insights and results.
   

  

**CULTURAL RELEVANCE**
 You stay close to what's happening in culture. Whether it's sport, fitness, gaming, creators or emerging consumer trends, you're constantly identifying opportunities where Red Bull can authentically become part of the conversation. You understand how culture evolves—and how brands can contribute in meaningful and unexpected ways.
   

  

**Your areas of knowledge and expertise that matter most for this role:**
* 5+ years of experience within Communications, PR, Brand Marketing or Creative Marketing, either client-side or agency-side.
* Proven experience developing communication strategies and creative campaigns for consumer brands, products or services.
* Experience launching products, seasonal campaigns or consumer-facing initiatives is highly valued.
* Strong understanding of how earned media, creator marketing, social media and brand communications reinforce each other.
* Excellent storytelling skills with the ability to identify communication opportunities that resonate with both media and consumers.
* Experience leading cross-functional projects involving multiple stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of the Swedish media landscape and today's digital communication ecosystem.
* Experience from FMCG, hospitality, lifestyle, retail, consumer brands or other fast-moving industries where creativity is essential to stand out is considered a strong advantage.
* Curious, proactive and highly creative, with a passion for developing ideas — not just communicating them.
* Excellent project management and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.


 Red Bull Sweden AB is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**REQ# FEQ427R66**
**Solutions Architect – Data & AI (Presales)**
 At Databricks, our Solutions Architects combine customer engagement with hands-on technical expertise.
   

  

 You will work closely with customers to understand their challenges and demonstrate how the Databricks platform can solve them – not just conceptually, but in practice.
   

  

 This role sits within our sales organization and is ideal for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of business, data, and AI — and who is motivated by turning ideas into working solutions.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Partner with Account Executives to drive technical sales cycles and customer outcomes
* Lead customer workshops, discovery sessions, and technical deep-dives across multiple stakeholders
* Build and deliver proof-of-concepts, demos, and solution prototypes using real data
* Translate business requirements into practical, scalable data and AI solutions
* Act as a trusted advisor, while also being able to go hands-on to validate solutions end-to-end
* Work through technical challenges with customers, iterating and resolving issues as they arise
* Contribute reusable assets, patterns, and best practices that accelerate adoption across customers


**What We’re Looking For**
**Customer-facing mindset**
* Experience working with customers in a presales, consulting, or advisory capacity
* Ability to communicate complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Comfortable leading discussions that connect business goals to technical decisions


**Hands-on technical foundation**
* Experience with Python (or similar) and familiarity with distributed data processing and compute and working with large-scale datasets
* Understanding of data pipelines and modern data architectures
* Ability to work practically with data (e.g. building PoCs, exploring datasets, troubleshooting)
* Comfortable reasoning through code, explaining how it works, and adapting it when things don’t behave as expected


**Data & AI understanding**
* Familiarity with analytics, data science, or machine learning workflows
* Understanding of how data platforms support AI use cases (e.g. feature pipelines, model training, inference)
* Interest in modern AI capabilities, combined with an understanding of how they operate on real data systems


**Architecture & platform understanding**
* Familiarity with cloud platforms and data technologies
* Ability to design solutions that consider scalability, performance, reliability, and data volumes
* Awareness of trade-offs in architecture decisions and ability to adapt designs based on constraints


**What Makes You Successful In This Role**
* You are comfortable switching between business dialogue and technical execution
* You don’t just describe solutions — you can build, validate, and iterate on them in practice
* You take ownership of technical challenges and push problems forward, even when things are not working as expected
* You apply structured thinking in discovery and can connect requirements to scalable technical solutions
* You understand that AI solutions depend on solid data foundations
* You are curious and continuously deepen your technical expertise


**About Databricks**
 Databricks is the data and AI company. More than 10,000 organizations worldwide — including Comcast, Condé Nast, Grammarly, and over 50% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform to unify and democratize data, analytics and AI. Databricks is headquartered in San Francisco, with offices around the globe and was founded by the original creators of Lakehouse, Apache Spark™, Delta Lake and MLflow. To learn more, follow Databricks on Twitter, LinkedIn and Facebook.

 At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

title: Identity Security Developer Sailpoint
description:
Are you ready for a change? To make the world a safer place?
   

  

 ID North offers products and services in the entire field of identity security (IAM, IGA, PAM), which is a central part of IT security. We are the leading company in Sweden and intend to further distance ourselves from the competition in the entire Nordics. We are on an exciting growth journey, which is why we are now looking for more solution developers who want to join our team and develop tomorrow’s identity security solutions for our customers!
   

  

**Your mission** 
 📌
   

  

 As a Developer, you will implement advanced solutions based on the customer’s needs and requirements, such as secure login, integration for automatic account creation, and management of administrator rights. The assignments are technically exciting and challenging, and those passionate about developing technical breadth are in the right place to become an expert. Working together in a project team with a project manager, solution architect, and solution developer, you will be involved in delivering top-notch identity security solutions within Project Delivery and/or our Service Delivery Organization!
   

  

**In your role, you will need to:** 
 💻
   

  

 Have an interest in configuring technically broad solutions in complex environments using market-leading products tailored to the customer’s needs.
   

  

 Be able to integrate systems for secure login and information flows for identities, accounts, and permissions.
   

  

 Work with customers and help them understand the solution being built.
   

  

 It is a merit to have worked with IAM, IGA, and/or PAM solutions before with the technology of one of our solution partners.
   

  

 Knowledge of Active Directory/LDAP, Web Services, and standards such as SAML, OpenID Connect, OAuth2, SCIM is advantageous.
   

  

 It is also a merit to have knowledge and experience with Linux and Windows environments, MySQL and MSSQL databases, Java and Tomcat, Apache httpd, certificate management/SSL/TLS/PKI.
   

  

 Version control and release management with tools like Subversion or Git, as well as Ant or Maven, are advantageous.
   

  

 Experience and knowledge with identity security products from SailPoint, Savyint Opentext, Okta, Nexus, CyberArk, Microsoft is a major plus.
   

  

 There may be business trips in the role. We have offices in Stockholm, Borås, Gothenburg, Denmark and Helsinki, so your location can be flexible based on your needs and life situation.
   

  

**Your competence** 
 📓
   

  

 We are looking for someone with an IT technical developer background. Experience and knowledge in identity security are highly valued but not a requirement. We prefer if you have worked in teams/projects with customers as consultants and are unafraid to take on new technical challenges. Understanding of information flows, system integration, and basic programming skills are advantageous. You can communicate fluently in both Swedish and English, both spoken and written. A major merit if you have other language skills.
   

  

**Your qualities** 
**⭐️**
 You enjoy working in teams with colleagues and customers, and you like to develop advanced technical solutions that require a broad technical understanding. We prefer that you are solution-oriented and interested in learning how to implement solutions with new products. Are eager to learn and develop your skills and competence. We value your personal qualities highly and are looking for someone who is attentive, has good social skills, and is easy to collaborate with others, both colleagues and customers.
   

  

**We offer** 
 🚀
   

  

 A strong and pleasant company at the forefront of our field, where our expertise and experience give us a competitive position. We offer development opportunities, and you will be surrounded by specialists. All day every day! At ID North, you have good employment benefits, and you will become a key person for us in our delivery. We enjoy each other’s company and take the opportunity to go on trips, adventures, and have fun together on our journey to the top.
   

  

 Does this sound like a position for you? We have an immediate need, so you should not hesitate to apply or send your application. Are you IN?
   

  

 Welcome- Chief Human Resources Officer Linda Öhlin

title: Information Risk and Compliance Officer
description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions.
   

  

 Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an Information Security Officer combined with an Cybersecurity Manager role in the area of Production & Logistics to be part of our exciting journey where we stand in front of a big change both when it comes to the way of working in the Production & Logistics business as well as the IT solutions that will support our business together with all what digitalization brings.
   

  

 The business architecture and IT solutions should be an enabler for our P&L business to take on new challenges and opportunities within our global production system. Our vison is that we should have an efficient, transparent and automated global production system, using modern digital solutions to connect our people, processes & equipment to support real time decisions based on high quality data.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities will be divided in two areas Information Security (ISec) and Product Cybersecurity (CS) both within Production and Logistics. As the Information Security Officer you will support the management within Production & Logistics in their Information Security responsibility and acts as an interface between business and Group ISec.
   

  

 This means that you will be responsible for our network of Local Information Security Officers. You will also work closely to our Information Management team and Business Architects, as well as our Project Managers and Product Owners. Within the area of Product Cybersecurity your role will be Cyber Security Manager. This means that you will be responsible for the Production & Logistics part of Scania’s Cybersecurity Management System and the network of cybersecurity coordinators. You will also work tightly with R&D both with Regulation Owners and Product Owners.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 As a person you are a self-driven curious team player with a genuine interest in Scania´s Products and Processes with focus on Information Security and Cybersecurity. You will build and maintain your network utilising established methodologies and your influencing skills to get buy-in on what needs to be addressed.
   

  

 We believe that you have a master of science in engineering or university degree in Information Science or have the corresponding knowledge. Working in the area between business and IT requires that you understand and can handle both perspectives. Furthermore you have good knowledge in Information Security and Cybersecurity as well as Scania´s business and processes within Production & Logistics.
   

  

 You have a good level in facilitating meetings and you are structured, pedagogic and communicative. You are experienced in leading and managing networks.
   

  

 To succeed in the role, you need social, analytic and leadership skills . You are used to take own initiatives to create and maintain structures.
   

  

 You are fluent in Swedish and English.
   

  

**Scania Offers**
 We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.
   

  

 With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.
   

  

 Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.
   

  

**Application**
 We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.
   

  

 Apply as soon as possible. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.
   

  

**We look forward to your application!**

title: Cloud Solution Architect
description:
As of 2 September 2025, Vivicta, former Tietoevry Tech Services, now operates as a standalone company under our new brand. We’ve officially launched Vivicta, your trusted Nordic transformation partner, making everyday easier through technology. You can explore more about our brand and what we stand for at https://www.vivicta.com
   

  

 Ready to join us? Click ‘Apply’ and complete our short application form to get started. Prefer another option? Apply via LinkedIn to automatically populate your details using your profile.
   

  

 Brinner du för att omsätta modern teknik till verklig affärsnytta? I så fall är detta rollen för dig. Vi på Vivicta söker just nu en
 **Cloud Solution Architect** 
 som vill vara med och effektivisera våra kunders verksamheter! Hos oss får du arbeta med Azure, Power Platform och Dynamics 365 i en roll där du både får tänka strategiskt och vara hands-on i lösningarna.
   

  

 Som konsult hos oss blir du en teknisk specialist inom Azure, Power Platform och Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain. Du blir en del av ett växande team där arbetet präglas av frihet under ansvar och nära samarbete med kund.
   

  

**Som Cloud Solution Architect på Vivicta kommer du att**
* Arbeta nära kund i en konsultativ roll för att effektivisera deras verksamhet
* Driva implementationer, utbildningar och vidareutveckling av lösningar
* Hitta och implementera de bästa tekniska lösningarna för våra kunder
* Vägleda och stötta utvecklingsteam i tekniska frågor
* Hjälpa kunder att optimera sina system och miljöer
* Delta i både projektleveranser och applikationsförvaltning
* Bidra i dialoger med nya och befintliga kunder tillsammans med säljteamet
* Arbeta i projekt som ofta har internationell prägel, tillsammans med ett erfaret team och med möjlighet att påverka både lösningar och arbetssätt.


**Vi söker dig som**
* Har erfarenhet av Azure, Microsoft Power Platform och Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain
* Har erfarenhet av integrationer mellan olika system
* Har arbetat med Microsofts utvecklingsverktyg, t.ex. Visual Studio och DevOps
* Är självgående, flexibel och resultatinriktad
* Har ett framåttänkande mindset och trivs i en agil miljö
* Har en stark vilja att utvecklas och hålla dig uppdaterad inom ny teknik
* Talar och skriver flytande svenska och engelska


**Det är meriterande om du också har**
* Djupare erfarenhet av Power Platform (t.ex. Logic Apps, Power Apps, Power BI, Dataverse)


**Vi erbjuder dig**
 Vi erbjuder dig professionell tillväxt, meningsfulla projekt, öppen kultur och en enastående balans mellan arbete och privatliv! Vi erbjuder dig en möjlighet att skapa framtiden för en snabbt växande och viktig sektor. Vi tror att vår organisationskultur är en viktig del för att du ska bli framgångsrik. Vi tillhandahåller en flexibel hybrid arbetsmodell som en del av vår kultur och vårt sätt att arbeta. Slutligen tror vi också på nyfikenhet och konstant lärande som en livsstil där du behöver skola om dig varje dag när nya möjligheter dyker upp.
   

  

**Hur du ansöker**
 Bifoga ditt CV eller LinkedIn-profil så kontaktar vi dig. Intervjuer kommer att hållas löpande, så vi uppmanar dig att söka redan idag. Om du har några frågor angående denna roll, vänligen kontakta anställande chef, Norman Fromy, norman.fromy@vivicta.com.
   

  

 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!
   

  

**Plats:** 
 Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Skellefteå/Hybrid
   

  

*Vi genomför bakgrundskontroller på alla slutkandidater, och vissa roller kan kräva säkerhetsprövning antingen under rekryteringen eller senare — alltid i enlighet med lokal lagstiftning samt med stor omsorg och konfidentialitet.*
*Vivicta tackar nej till samtal från rekryteringsföretag.*

title: Handläggare vårdinformatik
description:
Vill du vara med och påverka hur vårdkontakter beskrivs, rapporteras och analyseras i en av Sveriges största vårdorganisationer? Nu söker vi dig som vill ta en nyckelroll i vår förvaltning som handläggare inom rapportering och klassificering av vårdkontakter.
   

  





**Om tjänsten**




 Som handläggare inom vårdinformatik blir du en del av enheten för Vårdanalys och statistik som via vårdinformatikuppdraget arbetar för att säkerställa rätt beskrivning av vården genom korrekt användning av kodverk och klassifikationer för hälso-och sjukvård samt utveckling av dessa som grund för ersättning, uppföljning och styrning inom vården.
   

  





 Du arbetar nära dinkollega inom expertområdet och tillsammans bidrar ni till ett enhetligt och rättssäkert klassificeringsarbete som stödjer vårdens utveckling bland annat genom att utveckla framtagna regelverk, gällande klassifikationer och andra styrande dokument.
   

  





 Du kommer att samverka i olika projekt på förvaltningen som expert inom beskrivningssystem. Du kommer också att ansvara för information såväl muntlig som skriftlig för de nätverk inom området som vi deltar i. I arbetet ingår att självständigt utifrån regelverk m.m. kunna svara på vårdgivares och förvaltningens frågor inom vårdinformatik. Mycket av utvecklingsarbetet sker i samarbete med förvaltningens olika avdelningar, vårdgivare, nationella myndigheter och nätverk.
   

  





 Exempel på uppgifter som ingår i rollen:
 


* ansvara för att förvalta och utveckla regelverk, principer och riktlinjer för hur vårdkontakter klassificeras och rapporteras
* fungera som sakkunnig och stöd inom området gentemot förvaltning, vårdgivare, nätverk och myndigheter
* delta i projekt och utvecklingsarbeten kopplade till klassificering, vårddokumentation och informationsstruktur
* representera vårdinformatik i nationella och regionala nätverk
* bidra till utbildningsinsatser, informationsmaterial och dialogforum.



**Vem är du?**




 Vi ser att du är en person som gillar att samarbeta med andra och att bidra och kommunicera inom ditt expertområde. Att arbeta självständigt genom att själv driva och planera arbetsuppgifter är något du kan och är van vid att göra.Du kan omfamna komplexiteten i en stor organisation och tar lätt kontakt med andra människor för att lösa uppgifter. Du ser möjligheter i att arbeta i en föränderlig miljö och i detta kunna omprioritera och snabbt ställa om utifrån förändrade förutsättningar, förväntningar och behov.
   

  





 För att passa för rollen har du:
 


* eftergymnasial utbildning inom hälso- och sjukvård, vårdadministration eller motsvarande relevant område
* god kännedom och erfarenhet av primärklassificering
* goda kunskaperoch erfarenhet av hälso- och sjukvårdens administrativa system (journal – patientadministrativa system)
* förmåga att uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift på svenska
* goda kunskaper i Microsoft Office, särskilt Word och Excel.



 Vi ser det som meriterande om du dessutom har:
 


* utbildning inom kodning och klassificering
* erfarenhet av att arbeta som medicinsk sekreterare
* erfarenhet av att utbilda alt stötta andra inom kodning och klassificering
* erfarenhet av att arbeta med klassificeringssystem som KVÅ och DRG
* erfarenhet av webbredaktörskap



**Vårt erbjudande**




 Vi har kollektivavtal och med det följer kollektivavtalade försäkringar, tjänstepension och möjlighet till löneväxling. För att du ska kunna ta ansvar för din hälsa erbjuder vi friskvårdstimme och friskvårdsbidrag samt subventionerad sjukvård i form av kostnadsfri öppensjukvård. Flexibel arbetstid och möjlighet till att arbeta hemifrån har vi för att underlätta för dig att få ihop vardagen. Här kan du läsa mer om förmånerna i vårt kollektivavtal.
   

  





 Vi sitter i trevliga lokaler på Lindhagensgatan 98. Hit tar du dig enkelt med kollektivtrafiken, eller du kanske föredrar att cykla eller gå.
   

  





**Ansökan**




 Låter det här som något för dig ser vi gärna att du söker så snart som möjligt,intervjuer kan ske löpande. För en komplett ansökan räcker det med att bifoga ditt CV. När du ansöker kommer du att få besvara ett antal frågor, dessa ersätter personligt brev.
   

  





 Har du frågor är du välkommen att kontakta enhetschef Åsa Rosendahl: asa.rosendahl@regionstockholm.se.
   

  





 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!
   

  





 Hälso- och sjukvårdsförvaltningen stödjer Region Stockholms politiska organisation för att invånarna i Stockholms län har tillgång till en god och säker hälso- och sjukvård samt tandvård. Det innebär att förvaltningen beställer och följer upp hälso- och sjukvård och tandvård för 75 miljarder kronor årligen. Förvaltningen ansvarar också för kunskapsstyrningsorganisationen i Region Stockholm, samt en rad funktioner som är avgörande för hälso- och sjukvårdssystemet, såsom smittskydd, vårdhygien. Läs mer här

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELL
   

  

* You? A collaborative data professional who loves mentoring teams, setting clean architectural standards, and transforming data into highly reliable products.
* Role? A hands-on Lead Data Engineer with broad organizational scope, bridging the gap between high-level data strategy and day-to-day product engineering.
* Tech stack? Event-driven architectures (Kafka, CDC), schema management, and modern cloud data platforms like GCP/BigQuery or Snowflake.
* Company? Vend, home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA & Bilbasen, where millions of people across the Nordics connect to find what they need, whether it’s a job, a home, a way to move, or a fresh start.
* Location? Join us in our Stockholm, Oslo, Helsinki, Copenhagen or Krakow office with the flexibility to work 3 days per week remotely.
* Why us? This is your chance to make a profound impact by scaling our Data Mesh strategy across Vend's four core product verticals: Mobility, Real Estate, Jobs, and Recommerce. You will enjoy extensive professional growth, a culture built on mutual trust and psychological safety, and the autonomy to shape data maturity across a major Nordic technology ecosystem.


 Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!
   

  

 WHO ARE YOU?
   

  

* You bring deep expertise in event-driven architecture, including Kafka topic design, Change Data Capture (CDC), schema evolution, and both streaming and batch patterns.
* You have practical experience navigating cloud data platforms (such as GCP/BigQuery or Snowflake) alongside data quality frameworks and observability tools.
* You are a natural educator and coach who enjoys introducing modern data practices to product teams, meeting them where they are with patience and clarity.
* You thrive in a federated data ownership model (like Data Mesh) and feel comfortable guiding, aligning, and influencing cross-functional peers without needing direct authority.
* You are an effective communicator in English, which is our primary working language, enabling you to clearly translate technical "how-to" choices into meaningful "why" business value.


**WHAT’S THE JOB LIKE?**
 As a Lead Data Engineer, your mission is to bring our data strategy to life within your product organization. You will ensure our data products are architecturally sound, thoroughly documented, and highly usable for downstream consumers, not just technically present.
   

  

 Your Typical Week
   

  

 You will balance your time between deep technical reviews and collaborative human alignment. One day you might be diving into event schemas and Kafka topic designs; the next, you’ll be coaching a product team through their very first data product or collaborating with central platform teams to keep standards uniform.
   

  

 Current Projects & Focus Areas
   

  

* Championing the Data Operating Model: Serve as the core checkpoint for our Data Operating Model within your vertical, tracking progress against company-wide data product coverage goals.
* Team Enablement: Guide teams end-to-end, from initial event emission through our golden paths to a discoverable product in our data catalog.
* Lifecycle Management: Own the healthy evolution of your organization's data products, smoothly managing versioning, breaking changes, and deprecations.


 Collaboration & Stakeholders
   

  

 You will report directly to the CTO of your vertical while operating under the CPTO’s overarching data mandate. You will collaborate closely with peer Lead Data Engineers across Vend, our central platform infrastructure teams, and the product managers and engineers within your specific organization.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* After 6 months: You have built trusted relationships across your vertical, assessed current data product gaps, and successfully established initial quality and observability baselines.
* After 1 year: You have proven the success of our data strategy by delivering data products that actively drive revenue, optimize user experiences, or reduce time-to-insight across your vertical.


**What this role is NOT (to give you total clarity):**
* Not a platform engineer: You won’t be building Kafka clusters or maintaining Snowflake infrastructure—our dedicated central platform team handles that heavy lifting.
* Not an analytics engineer: You won’t own dbt models or build dashboards. Your focus is ensuring the foundation feeding the analytical layer is rock solid.
* Not a people manager: This is an individual contributor (IC) role focused on broad organizational influence, mentorship, and technical leadership rather than administration.


 Want to get a feel for our culture and what drives us? Take a peek behind the scenes at our Career Page!
   

  

 GOT YOUR ATTENTION? Let us hear from you!
   

  

 Make sure to apply by
 **10th August 2026.** 
 Please note that due to the summer/holidays, we will process all applications in mid-August
   

  

 QUESTIONS?
   

  

**David Johansson Rad, Senior Manager, Project Management,** 
 is happy to provide information about the daily work and answer any questions you may have about the role. David is best reached via david.johansson.rad@vend.com (Do note he will be on leave, so expect some delays)
   

  

 For questions regarding the recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to our Senior Talent Acquisition Partner,
 **Clayton Don Corda,** 
 at clayton.don.corda@vend.com

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
   

  

 Do you want to work with one of Sweden’s most critical IT infrastructures? We are looking for an Infrastructure Engineer / System Programmer (SysProg) to join our mainframe team and help operate and modernise our z/OS platform in a highly secure, business critical environment.
   

  

**The role**
 You will be part of a skilled mainframe team responsible for the stability, availability, and evolution of our z/OS environment. The role combines deep technical system programming with operational responsibility and close collaboration across IT and the business.
   

  

 In this role you will play a key role in:
   

  

* System programming and maintenance of z/OS and related subsystems
* Work closely with domain owners for MQ on z/OS, IMS and/or DB2 (depending on your profile)
* Software installation, upgrades, and maintenance using SMP/E
* Incident investigation, problem management, and operational support
* Manage certificates, encryption, and security related configurations
* Participate in on call duty and planned infrastructure activities, such as datacentre swaps and major changes
* Contribute to modernisation, automation, and continuous improvements


**Your profile**
* Has solid experience working with IBM z/OS in a system programming or senior infrastructure role
* Strong knowledge of software maintenance and installation using SMP/E
* Solid understanding of mainframe security, including certificates, PKI, encryption, and key management
* Is comfortable working in 24/7, high availability environments
* Is structured, proactive, and enjoys taking ownership
* Enjoys working both independently and as part of a small expert team
* Curious and motivated to continuously develop your skills
* Calm and methodical under pressure in incident situations


**Nice to have**
* Cross platform integration (z/OS ↔ distributed systems)
* Experience from financial or other regulated environments
* Automation, monitoring, and alerting on the mainframe
* Knowledge of additional z/OS subsystems or middleware products


**What We Believe You Will Enjoy About Working Here**
* A key role in Sweden’s financial market infrastructure
* A collaborative, highly skilled technical environment
* Competitive benefits and flexible working conditions


**Application**
 Due to vacation period we will start process applications second week of August.
   

  

*As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card, and background checks will be carried out as required. Due to vacation period, applications reeived from mid July will be processed second week of August.*

We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

title: DevOps - Principal
description:
**Who We Are**
 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Every day, our cloud-native acquiring platform processes billions of card transactions — authorization, clearing, and settlement — for customers who trust us to get it right, every time. We're building an internal Engineering Platform that lets our product teams move fast without reinventing infrastructure each time. You'll join the Platform Engineering team to design self-service tooling that developers actually want to use: fewer tickets, fewer handoffs, less time fighting security and compliance, more time shipping. If you like building the systems other engineers build on top of, read on.
   

  

**Day-to-day Responsibilities**
 You'll help build and run the platform that lets developers independently create, test, launch, and monitor our real-time authorization services. Concretely, that means designing and delivering an internal platform that:
   

  

* Gives development teams seamless, self-service access to the tools they need
* Cuts non-development overhead and cross-team delays
* Reduces the cognitive load of security, governance, and compliance
* Enables fast, independent software delivery
* Ties success to clear, observable business outcomes


 You'll work in a focused, domain-driven team and take part in an on-call rotation. Your work directly enables internal teams to innovate and operate at scale.
   

  

**Who Are We Looking For**
 We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what's next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:
   

  

* 5+ years hands-on software development, with strong production Python experience. Comfortable with Git.
* Solid grasp of SSO, authentication, and access control — with exposure to AWS Cognito, Flask, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect.
* Strong in Python and Go, with deep knowledge of REST APIs and HTTP(S), including managing proxies and requests with NGINX.
* Extensive AWS experience — ELB, Route 53, Lambda, IAM, DynamoDB, S3, RDS — plus cloud-native networking: VPCs, subnets, peering, transit gateways, service meshes, NATs, and firewalls.
* Experience with AWS multi-account strategies and automating account provisioning through Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* Practical CI/CD experience with Jenkins and Docker, ideally on AWS ECS.
* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar.
* Fluent in English and/or Swedish, with a valid Swedish work permit.
* Bonus: some React experience.
* Care about giving teams autonomy — so features ship faster and production issues get resolved quicker
* Are a self-starter who's also a genuine team player: accountable, dependable, and good at working across groups
* Communicate clearly and build strong working relationships
* Stay comfortable with ambiguity and bring a learning mindset
* Enjoy mentoring other engineers


**Nice to have**
* Hands-on DevOps culture: automation, lean processes, metrics, and resilience
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (or equivalent expertise)
* Experience applying AI-driven approaches to operations and tooling, and scaling them
* Public code, writing, or projects that show your work
* Experience building secure and/or PCI-DSS certified solutions


**Perks & Benefits**
* Competitive salary
* 30 days' annual leave
* Private medical insurance
* Attractive stakeholder pension scheme
* Flexible benefits scheme with discounted products and services
* Comprehensive training and development programs — we're serious about growing your career


**Shape the evolution**
 We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com
   

  

 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Teknisk specialist – Videoplattformar & Streaming
description:
Är du redo för en större uppgift?
   

  

**Organisation** 
 It-avdelningen
 **Kommun** 
 Stockholm
 **Län** 
 Stockholms län
 **Utlyst** 
 31 juli 2026
 **Ansök senast** 
 24 augusti 2026
 **Referensnummer** 
 A411.266/2026
   

  

 Arbetsplatsbeskrivning
   

  

 IT-avdelningens främsta uppgift är att tillhandahålla IT-tjänster till hela Polismyndigheten.
   

  

 IT-avdelningen en viktig del av det brottsförebyggande och brottsbekämpande arbetet och IT är ett av de viktigaste verktygen för att effektivisera polisen och öka kvaliteten i polisarbetet. Vi utvecklar och moderniserar polisens IT och myndigheten satsar mycket på att stärka avdelningen med ny specialistkompetens och den senaste teknologin till nytta för medborgarna och medarbetarna i den polisiära verksamheten. IT-avdelningen består för närvarande av omkring 1400 anställda som ansvarar för all IT som används av myndighetens 40 000 anställda. Vårt kontor är beläget i centrala Stockholm där vi erbjuder både flexibelt kontor och flexibla arbetstider. För närvarande finns det även möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån upp till två dagar i veckan.
   

  

 Till vårt team Digital kommunikation söker vi nu en teknikspecialist som är analytisk, noggrann och strukturerad. Hos oss kommer du tillsammans med engagerade och trevliga kollegor utvecklas och få erfarenheter för livet, samtidigt som ditt arbete bidrar till att öka tryggheten och minska brottsligheten i Sverige. Bygg framtidens kommunikationsinfrastruktur för Polismyndigheten.
   

  

 Är du redo att ta ditt tekniska kunnande inom video, streaming och collaboration till nästa nivå?
   

  

 Vi söker nu en driven Teknisk specialist till vårt team Digital kommunikation. Här blir du en viktig spelare i att designa och driva de videomiljöer som binder samman 40 000 polisanställda över hela landet.
   

  

 Arbetsbeskrivning
   

  

 Med 1400 medarbetare på IT levererar vi kritiska tjänster som möjliggör både brottsförebyggande och brottsbekämpande arbete. Vi satsar stort på modernisering och söker dig som vill vara med och forma hur polisen kommunicerar imorgon och framöver.
   

  

 Som teknisk specialist ansvarar du för hela livscykeln för våra videolösningar – från arkitektur och design till drift och optimering. Du kommer att hantera en komplex miljö där hög tillgänglighet och säkerhet är icke-förhandlingsbart.
   

  

**Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden** 
 :
   

  

* Du designar, utvecklar och förvaltar avancerade videomiljöer, endpoints, digital signage och streamingtjänster.
* Du fungerar som bryggan mellan infrastrukturteam, applikationsutvecklare och verksamheten och säkerställer att tekniken möter användarnas behov.
* Du arbetar med kravställning och deltar i upphandlingsprocesser, för att säkra bästa möjliga tekniklösningar.
* Du arbetar med att dokumentera lösningar, upprätta rutiner och dela med dig av din expertis internt.


 Kvalifikationer
   

  

**För den här rollen behöver du:**
* Gymnasieutbildning inom relevant område eller motsvarande kompetens, som polismyndigheten bedömer som motsvarande.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med infrastruktur, så som Nätverksinfrastruktur, serverkonfigurering, IP-adressering, brandväggsregler och certifikathantering.
* Du har en mycket god svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
* Du har svenskt medborgarskap.
* Du trivs bäst i gränslandet mellan djupt tekniskt fördjupningsarbete och strategisk samordning.


 Meriterande:
   

  

 För att lyckas fullt ut i rollen ser vi gärna att du även har erfarenhet av:
   

  

* Stora, komplexa IT-miljöer med höga krav på driftsäkerhet (gärna från myndighet eller annan reglerad verksamhet där infrastrukturen anses vara kritisk).
* Erfarenhet av design, drift och förvaltning av videomiljöer. Du har goda kunskaper i Cisco-ekosystemet (CUCM, TMS, Expressway, CMS) eller motsvarande plattformar.
* Virtualisering och drift av virtuella servrar.


**Personliga egenskaper**
 Du är initiativtagande och driver för att komma framåt inom dina områden. När komplexa problem uppstår ser du möjligheter i att arbeta metodiskt och att få en större förståelse och kunskap. Du är flexibel och växlar naturligt mellan att arbeta självständigt med tekniska djupdykningar och att samarbeta i team för att leverera helhetslösningar.
   

  

 Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.
   

  

 Kontaktpersoner
   

  

 Har du frågor om uppdraget är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef: 010-566 69 07
