* ID 508296-en\_US
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.


**The Role**
------------


You will take ownership of a major telecom client and play a central role in driving growth through our extensive portfolio, such as Customer Experience, Insights and Data, Enterprise systems, Cloud and Custom Applications, Cloud and Infrastructure etc.
  

This is a high-impact, client-facing role where we expect you to build valuable solutions, by activating our existing client relations while bringing the best of Capgemini in identifying client needs, turning them into winning solutions delivering Client Value.


You will guide key stakeholders, drive strategic conversations, and work closely with internal experts and partners to shape opportunities from first contact to successful execution and completion.
  

This is a role for someone who thrives on driving client value through solution-selling by bringing your own expertise but also to coordinate different capabilities to bring forward the most impactful solutions to your client.

  

  

Your responsibilities will include:


* Build and develop trusted relationships with key client stakeholders
* Identify client needs, challenges and opportunities to create new business value
* Drive the full sales cycle from early engagement to closed deals and delivery
* Lead client dialogues, proposals and negotiations together with internal experts and partners
* Build, manage and prioritize a strong pipeline to ensure continuous growth
**Your profile**
----------------


* We are looking for an experienced Account Manager who is driven by winning new business and growing strategic accounts. You enjoy taking ownership of the entire journey, from building relationships and uncovering needs to closing deals and ensuring successful delivery.
* You are confident in complex client environments and combine a strong commercial mindset with the ability to translate business needs into tangible solutions. You are persistent, structured and motivated by generating results over time.
  

  

We believe you bring:


* Several years of experience in sales and account management within the IT services industry, preferably telecom
* A proven track record of building pipeline and closing business
* Experience of working end-to-end from lead generation to deal closure and deliver
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to act as a trusted advisor
* A good understanding of hyperscaler-driven solutions both applications and infra
**What we belive you will enjoy about working here**.


* Freedom to shape your work and operate with high autonomy in a senior sales role
* You enjoy working in a fast-paced, international environment where you are measured on your ability to build pipeline, win business and deliver results
* At Capgemini, you get the freedom to act, the support of strong teams and partners, and the opportunity to continuously grow both your accounts and your career.
* A culture shaped by Capgemini’s core values: Honesty, Boldness, Trust, Freedom, Team Spirit, Modesty, and Fun, where you actively contribute to bringing these values to life every day
* A comprehensive benefits package supporting your wellbeing and work-life balance
  

  

**Application**

* *As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card, and background checks may be carried out as required*
  

  

**About Capgemini**

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

title: Team Manager Network Strategy & Device
description:
The Network Strategy & Solutions department is shaping Tre’s technical development across our Swedish and Danish networks. We are in an exciting phase where long-term network strategy meets the next generation of mobile technology, from 5G Standalone and future RAN functionality to AI-enabled and autonomous networks. Now we are looking for a leader who can help turn this strategic agenda into clear direction, strong execution and lasting impact.
  
  

About the role As Team Manager Network Strategy & Device, you will lead one of the most senior specialist teams in our technology organisation. The team works at the heart of mobile network evolution, with responsibilities spanning RAN strategy, network evolution, future 5G functionality, device-related quality assurance and close collaboration between Sweden and Denmark.
  
  

This is a role for a strong people manager who understands telecom and knows how to lead experts. You will have full people responsibility from day one, including goals, development, follow-up and competence growth. Your mission is to create structure, direction and priorities in a highly skilled team, while ensuring that specialist knowledge continues to thrive.
  
A key part of the role is to translate strategy into execution. You will help the team focus on the areas that matter most for Tre’s future network development, including RAN strategy and network evolution, 5G Standalone and future network functionality, network slicing and traffic differentiation, as well as AI and autonomous networks.
  
  

You will work closely with Access Networks in Sweden and Denmark, radio planning, core, transmission, commercial stakeholders and external partners such as RAN and device vendors. You will also be part of the Network Strategy & Solutions leadership context, contributing to the wider technology agenda and helping us connect network capabilities to customer value and business impact.
  
  

**You can look forward to:**  

* Leading one of the industry’s most experienced and knowledgeable specialist teams
* Having a real opportunity to influence the future mobile networks in Sweden and Denmark
* Driving development within 5G SA, AI and autonomous networks
* Working in a strategic area where technology, customer experience and business value meet
* Be part of one of Sweden’s best workplaces (Great Place to Work 2026)


This is how the hiring manager, Peter, describes his leadership style:
  
  

"For me, leadership is about being present, supportive, and creating the right conditions for the team to succeed together. I believe in the power of collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning. Psychological safety is a key foundation for high performance, while I also place great importance on clear goals, expectations, and results. When we support one another, embrace different perspectives, and work towards a shared vision, we achieve the best outcomes.”
  
  

Work with great people
  
Julia Maxén
  
Team Manager
  
"I want my team to have the best conditions to excel in their roles. By empowering each member to perform at their best, we not only grow stronger as a team but also drive Tre forward to new heights"
  
Henrik Sundvall
  
Digital Project Lead
  
"The absolute best thing about being a project manager at Tre is that I get to work broadly with colleagues from all parts of the organization and learn new things every day. I have the freedom to be myself – and be appreciated for it!"
  
Jayasri Battola
  
Developer
  
"The great work culture and the technology made me choose Tre. Working alongside great people in mixed team setups, with both experienced and new talents, along with the latest and greatest tools and technologies like Cloud and Azure."
  
  

Who are you?
  
We believe you are a confident and engaging people leader with experience from leading specialists in a complex technical environment. You know how to create trust, direction and momentum in teams where the expertise is deep and the individuals are highly independent. You bring clarity without micromanaging and structure without slowing down innovation.
  
  

You have a solid understanding of telecom, preferably mobile networks and RAN, and you are comfortable discussing technology with senior experts and stakeholders. You do not need to be the deepest technical specialist in every area, but you need enough domain understanding to ask the right questions, challenge priorities and earn credibility in the room. A deeper technical background within RAN, 4G/5G, 5G SA, network evolution, slicing or autonomous networks is highly valued.
  
  

As a person, you are structured, communicative and business-oriented. You can translate strategic direction into practical priorities, align stakeholders across Sweden and Denmark and help a senior team lift its perspective from individual deliveries to the broader technology and business goals. You are fluent in English, both spoken and written, and you are willing to be based in Stockholm with regular presence and travel to Denmark. If you are proficient in Swedish, it will be considered an advantage.
  
  

Welcome with your application!
  
  

We accept applications through this job advertisement and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. A cover letter is not required; however, we kindly ask you to submit your CV and answer the questions provided below as part of your application.
  
  

To ensure an objective and fair selection process, we use assessment tests during recruitment. The position may be filled before the application deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
  
  

A background check will be conducted on the final candidate before an employment decision is made.
  
  

For more information about the role, please contact the hiring manager, Peter Dahlberg, at Peter.Dahlberg@tre.se.
  
  

Great Place to Work
  
  

Health care allowance, parental pay, pension & insurance according to collective agreements
  
  

Dog zone & gym in the 3house
  
  

Great discounts on bicycles, public transport, and electric cars
  
  

Flexible holidays and six extra days off per year
  
  

Subsidized lunch
  
  

Generous bonus models or commissions
  
  

We are driven by constantly trying to improve things in new and different ways. Of course, we are at the forefront of developing future networks.
  
  

We see ourselves as a crucial part of Sweden's social structure because we know that reliable connectivity is a necessary foundation stone in today's digital world. That's why we see it as our job to keep our mobile network up and running year-round, 24/7, to ensure you can always count on being connected when you need it most.
  
  

Tre was born as a challenger and is an organization in constant motion. We strive to be at the forefront of everything we do. We are convinced that the people at Tre are decisive for our development.
  
  

No matter how you start your journey at Tre, there are endless opportunities to grow and develop with us.
  
  

WE THINK LIKE CHALLENGERS - In a constantly changing world, we stay curious and open minded. Born with a challenger mindset, we love pushing boundaries.
  
  

WE WORK LIKE CHAMPIONS - As true champions, we always do our best. We take ownership, set clear goals and stay focused. Together we´re on a winning streak.
  
  

WE ACT LIKE BUDDIES - Free to be ourselves, we treat each other with respect. Together we make a friendly bunch, born, and one tough force.

title: Uppdragsledare till brottsbekämpande verksamhetssystem
description:
Uppdragsledare


**Organisation**It-avdelningen
**Kommun**Stockholm
**Län**Stockholms län
**Utlyst**31 juli 2026
**Ansök senast**14 augusti 2026
**Referensnummer**A406.325/2026
**Arbetsplatsbeskrivning**
--------------------------


Vill du bidra till Polisens uppdrag – att öka tryggheten och minska brottsligheten i samhället? Det kan du göra genom att arbeta hos oss.


Vi verkar inom ett spännande men komplext och föränderligt verksamhetsområde där vi stärker myndighetens brottsbekämpande möjligheter med förmågor inom it-brott och it-forensik. Vi ansvarar för Polisens spetskompetens inom områdena inhämtning, bearbetning och analys av digital bevisning. Produktportföljen består huvudsakligen av inköpta system men innehåller även egenutvecklade system inom området.


För att lyckas i vårt uppdrag arbetar vi nära verksamheten och tillsammans i vår interna organisation på It-avdelningen. Som medarbetare har du stor möjlighet att planera det dagliga arbetet med flexibla arbetstider och med möjlighet till distansarbete 2 dagar i veckan. Placering i Stockholm.


**Arbetsbeskrivning**
---------------------


Som uppdragsledare hos oss får du en central roll i att planera, leda och följa upp tekniska uppdrag samt implementera nya förmågor inom områdena IT-brott och IT-forensik. Rollen innebär nära samarbete med verksamhetsrepresentanter från den forensiska labbverksamheten samt den polisiära utrednings- och underrättelseverksamheten.


Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter kommer att vara:


* Leda och samordna tekniska uppdrag och aktiviteter inom IT-avdelningen
* Säkerställa leverans enligt tidplan och kvalitetskrav
* Koordinera resurser och hantera beroenden mellan uppdrag
* Delta i planering, uppföljning och rapportering till uppdragsgivare
* Bidra till kontinuerlig förbättring av arbetssätt, processer och rutiner
* Granska teknisk dokumentation i syfte att utvärdera produkters lämplighet för implementation i myndighetens miljö
**Kvalifikationer**
-------------------


Detta är en möjlighet för dig som har:


* Akademisk utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som relevant, företrädesvis inom IT, systemvetenskap eller teknik alternativt motsvarade arbetserfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer som relevant
* Några års dokumenterad arbetserfarenhet av uppdragsledning eller projektledning, företrädesvis inom områdena teknik, IT eller infrastruktur som myndigheten bedömer relevant för uppdraget
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift
* Svenskt medborgarskap

**Det är meriterande om du även har:**


* Erfarenhet av arbete i komplexa IT-miljöer, exempelvis on-prem, hybrid och Cloud
* Förståelse av IT-infrastruktur eller systemintegration
  

inom områden som nätverk, servrar, molnlösningar, applikationsdrift eller integration mellan olika system
* God förståelse för IT-säkerhet, informationssäkerhet, lagring, behörighetshantering samt olika operativsystem

**Personliga egenskaper**
  

Vi söker dig som tar ansvar för din uppgift driver arbete framåt på ett effektivt och strukturerat sätt. Du trivs i en samordnade roll, är duktig på att upprätthålla kontakter och har en god samarbetsförmåga då tjänsten innebär ett brett samarbete med olika aktörer och kompetenser. Som person räds du inte av utmaningar utan förblir motiverad och har lösningsorienterat och analytiskt förhållningssätt. Du drivs av att lära dig nya saker och tar ansvar för att identifiera vilken kompetens du behöver för att möta verksamhetens krav framåt. Vidare är du skicklig att på pedagogiskt sätt kommunicera såväl skriftligt som muntligt. Tjänsten ställer höga krav på säkerhet och tillgänglighet.


Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.


**Kontaktpersoner**
-------------------


Har du frågor om uppdraget är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef: 010-5628171.


Har du frågor gällande rekryteringsprocessen kontakta ansvarig HR-konsult: Linda Hempel Gustafson, linda.hempel-gustafson@polisen.se


**Fackliga företrädare**
------------------------


Saco-S, saco-s.avdelningarna@polisen.se


Polisförbundet, Sofia Ask, tfn 010-563 87 10


ST, st.inom-polisen@polisen.se


Seko Polisen, Karna Tillheden, tfn 073-249 04 22


**Övrig information**
---------------------


Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning, provanställning tillämpas
  

Anställningsbenämning: Handläggare
  

Arbetsort: Stockholm
  

Arbetstid: Förtroendearbetstid

title: Sr. Account Manager
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.


**The Role**
------------


You will take ownership of a major telecom client and play a central role in driving growth through our extensive portfolio, such as Customer Experience, Insights and Data, Enterprise systems, Cloud and Custom Applications, Cloud and Infrastructure etc.
  

This is a high-impact, client-facing role where we expect you to build valuable solutions, by activating our existing client relations while bringing the best of Capgemini in identifying client needs, turning them into winning solutions delivering Client Value.


You will guide key stakeholders, drive strategic conversations, and work closely with internal experts and partners to shape opportunities from first contact to successful execution and completion.
  

This is a role for someone who thrives on driving client value through solution-selling by bringing your own expertise but also to coordinate different capabilities to bring forward the most impactful solutions to your client.

  

  

Your responsibilities will include:


* Build and develop trusted relationships with key client stakeholders
* Identify client needs, challenges and opportunities to create new business value
* Drive the full sales cycle from early engagement to closed deals and delivery
* Lead client dialogues, proposals and negotiations together with internal experts and partners
* Build, manage and prioritize a strong pipeline to ensure continuous growth
**Your profile**
----------------


* We are looking for an experienced Account Manager who is driven by winning new business and growing strategic accounts. You enjoy taking ownership of the entire journey, from building relationships and uncovering needs to closing deals and ensuring successful delivery.
* You are confident in complex client environments and combine a strong commercial mindset with the ability to translate business needs into tangible solutions. You are persistent, structured and motivated by generating results over time.
  

  

We believe you bring:


* Several years of experience in sales and account management within the IT services industry, preferably telecom
* A proven track record of building pipeline and closing business
* Experience of working end-to-end from lead generation to deal closure and deliver
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to act as a trusted advisor
* A good understanding of hyperscaler-driven solutions both applications and infra
**What we belive you will enjoy about working here**.


* Freedom to shape your work and operate with high autonomy in a senior sales role
* You enjoy working in a fast-paced, international environment where you are measured on your ability to build pipeline, win business and deliver results
* At Capgemini, you get the freedom to act, the support of strong teams and partners, and the opportunity to continuously grow both your accounts and your career.
* A culture shaped by Capgemini’s core values: Honesty, Boldness, Trust, Freedom, Team Spirit, Modesty, and Fun, where you actively contribute to bringing these values to life every day
* A comprehensive benefits package supporting your wellbeing and work-life balance
  

  

**Application**

* *As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card, and background checks may be carried out as required*
  

  

**About Capgemini**

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
  

  

**Make it real** | www.capgemini.com

title: Lead Qualification Specialist (part-time)
description:
TaxiCaller is on a mission to transform the transportation industry, providing our cloud services to taxi and bus companies around the world. We grow at a good pace and we are profitable.
  
We are now looking for a Lead Qualification Specialist to our growing sales team in Linköping.
  
  

About you
  
* Excellent verbal communication skills and a friendly, confident phone manner.
* You communicate clearly in English both verbally and in writing. It's a big plus if you also speak Spanish.
* Strong listening and interpersonal abilities.
* Prior experience in customer service, telemarketing, or sales is an advantage.
* Organized and detail-oriented with good note-taking and data entry skills.


About the position
  
We’re looking for a motivated and personable Lead Qualification Specialist to join our team on a part-time basis. In this role, you’ll be responsible for reaching out to potential clients who have already contacted us or signed up for a free trial.
  
You will be engaging them in friendly and professional conversations, and determining whether they’re a good fit for our cloud service.
  
Your work will play a vital part in helping our sales team focus their efforts on high-quality, well-qualified leads.
  
The working hours will be 13.00 to 17.00, Monday to Friday. The working hours can be slightly adjusted, but the work needs to be done in the afternoon.
  
  

Your daily tasks will include
  
* Make outbound calls to leads who have contacted us.
* Engage prospects in meaningful conversations to assess their needs, size and level of interest.
* Accurately document call outcomes and update our CRM system.
* Provide feedback and insights to enhance our lead generation and qualification processes.
* Collaborate closely with the sales and marketing teams.


It will be considered an advantage if
  
* You speak additional languages, especially Swedish, Finnish, or French.


For this position you need to already have a Swedish work permit.
  
  

**You can learn more about working with us here:** https://www.taxicaller.com/en/careers and here www.linkedin.com/company/taxicaller.
  
Recruitment will continue until we feel we’ve found the right fit, so we recommend applying as soon as possible and we look forward to hearing from you!

title: Junior Account Manager (English and Spanish speaking) to Linköping
description:
The company has developed a groundbreaking cloud service for transportation companies. They have customers all over the world.
  
They are experiencing strong demand of their product and because of that they need to strengthen their sales with a Spanish and English speaking salesperson.
  
We are looking for an outgoing and self-motivated Spanish and English speaking person who wants to work with sales from the company's office in Linköping towards North America.
  
  

About you
  
Qualifications for this job
  
* A couple of years’ experience in B2B sales.
* Good track record in cold calling and outbound sales.
* Excellent customer assistance and problem solving skills.
* Fluent in English and Spanish with no accent.


We see it as a positive if you have previous experience in working with international SaaS sales.
  
  

About this position
  
You will mostly work with assigned qualified leads, but you will also work with outbound sales, e.g. cold calling.
  
A lead is a transportation company who is looking to upgrade their booking system.
  
You will work with the full sales cycle from first demo to a closed deal. After the deal is closed you will continue working with the customers to make sure we keep them happy.
  
The sales will mainly be done via web meetings and phone, so travelling will not be required for this position.
  
It is a very developing job in an international environment where you will interact with a lot of people every day.

title: Senior Account Executive - Digital Natives
description:
**Overview**  

Join Microsoft's Digital Natives team and work with some of the most innovative technology companies across Northern Europe. In this role, you will partner with high-growth organizations to help them achieve their business goals through cloud, data, and AI solutions.


As a Senior Account Executive, you will build trusted relationships with business and technology leaders, gaining a deep understanding of their priorities, challenges, and growth strategies. You will help customers accelerate their digital transformation journeys by connecting business needs with Microsoft solutions that drive measurable outcomes.


You will lead account strategy and execution, identify opportunities for growth, and collaborate across Microsoft and partner teams to deliver value for customers. Success in this role requires strong relationship-building skills, strategic thinking, commercial acumen, and the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments.


You will also work closely with senior decision-makers, developing business cases and solution strategies that support customer objectives while contributing to Microsoft's growth across the region.


This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of technology and business transformation, helping some of Europe's most innovative companies unlock new possibilities with Microsoft's cloud and AI platform.


At Microsoft, our mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth‑mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress, people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Build and strengthen relationships with business and technology decision-makers to understand customer priorities and create long-term value.
* Develop and execute account strategies that align customer objectives with Microsoft solutions and services.
* Identify new business opportunities, expand existing engagements, and support revenue and consumption growth across assigned accounts.
* Act as a trusted advisor by bringing industry insights, market trends, and innovative approaches to customer conversations.
* Lead cross-functional virtual teams and partner ecosystems to deliver customer outcomes and a seamless engagement experience.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and partners to address customer challenges, remove blockers, and support successful adoption of solutions.
* Maintain a healthy business pipeline, manage account priorities, and contribute to forecasting and business planning activities.
  

**Qualifications**  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Technology, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, **OR** equivalent professional experience.
* Experience in technology sales, account management, business development, or customer-facing commercial roles.
* Experience building relationships with business and technical decision-makers and managing complex customer engagements.
* Experience driving sales of Cloud and/or AI solutions

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience working with technology startups, scaleups, or rapidly growing digital businesses.
* Experience engaging with venture capital (VC), private equity (PE), or investment-backed organizations.
* Experience leading strategic customer conversations focused on business transformation, innovation, or cloud technologies.
* Experience working across multiple stakeholders and collaborating in a matrixed environment

title: Senior AI Cloud Architect Public 360°- Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior AI Cloud Architect (AI Platform)- Public 360°- Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)**
*Tietoevry Public 360 - building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.*
**About The Role**
 Public 360 integrates cloud-based AI capabilities into standard enterprise software. We are building solutions for 600+ public organizations in the Nordics, and our AI platform runs customer deployments at scale and is evolving fast with GenAI and agentic AI.
   

  

 As Senior AI Cloud Architect, you own the cloud architecture for our AI platform and shared services. You will define reference architectures, make key technology choices (Microsoft-first, but open), and ensure security, reliability, and automation as we scale.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Design and evolve the target architecture for a public-cloud-first AI platform (Azure preferred).
* Exploration of alternative deployment strategies for high-security customers
* Build secure, compliant foundations: landing zones, identity, networking, encryption, secrets, logging, and policy-as-code.
* Architect for scale and automation: infrastructure as code, CI/CD, GitOps, self-service environments, and operational runbooks.
* Own platform reliability: observability, SLOs, incident patterns, performance, and cost optimization (FinOps).
* Define patterns for AI product integration: APIs, event-driven processing, data pipelines, and multi-tenant considerations.
* Partner with AI engineers/data scientists on MLOps and LLMOps: model delivery pipelines, feature stores, evaluation, and monitoring.
* Drive security and Trustworthy AI practices together with security, privacy, and product teams (GDPR and data residency aware).
* Support solutioning and pre-sales when needed, and mentor architects/engineers across product teams.


**What You Bring**
* Senior – 8-10+ years of relevant experience, including service or solution architecture in complex product environments. More junior profiles will be considered in case of relevant experience – not the time but the type of experience and responsibility is important to us.
* Strong public cloud architecture skills (Azure: AKS/Container Apps, Functions, App Service, API Management, Event Hubs/Service Bus, Storage, SQL/Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Entra ID).
* Experience with multiple deployment scenarios and high security requirements is a plus
* Hands-on experience with automation: Terraform and/or Bicep, CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub), and modern deployment practices.
* Proven security architecture skills: threat modeling, zero trust, network segmentation, secrets management, vulnerability management, and audit readiness.
* Experience building or operating AI/ML platforms: Azure ML/MLflow, model serving, data pipelines, and LLM integration patterns.
* Ability to translate business needs into pragmatic architectures and communicate clearly with both engineers and stakeholders.


**Nice to have**
* Experience with GenAI platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI) and guardrails: content filters, prompt injection defense, red teaming, and evaluation.
* Knowledge of data engineering components: Databricks/Spark, Delta Lake, data streaming, and search/vector databases.
* Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Security Engineer, or similar.


**Impact you will have**
* Own the reference architecture for our cloud-first AI platform supporting AI capabilities for public organizations in the Nordics.
* Raise the security and compliance baseline with zero-trust patterns, policy-as-code, and audit-ready controls.
* Increase delivery speed and consistency through automation: self-service environments.
* Improve reliability and cost efficiency with SLO-driven operations, observability, and FinOps practices.


**Tech we use**
 Azure-first and automation-driven: containers/Kubernetes, serverless, messaging, IaC (Terraform/Bicep), CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub), observability, and cloud security tooling. We are open to AWS/GCP experience.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like In 6 Months**
* A clear platform roadmap indicating the next steps for our data and ai platform as baseline for our product teams, supporting our vision of AI-first and agentic-first software offerings in the public sector domain.
* Review and implementation of defined improvements of automation framework and pipelines in place for core platform services.
* Operational excellence established: dashboards, SLOs, alerting, and incident playbooks used in day-to-day operations.
* Security and Trustworthy AI governance embedded: threat models, risk assessments, and guardrail patterns for GenAI use cases.


**Why join us**
* Build technology that improves citizen services - with real-world scale and meaningful impact.
* A highly skilled, collaborative environment with room to influence architecture decisions end-to-end.
* Modern cloud-first stack, strong focus on security and responsible AI, and freedom to explore new approaches (including agentic AI).
* Professional growth, international collaboration, and a culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership.


**Practicalities**
 Location and work setup: flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen or Espoo). Fluent English required; Nordic language skills are a plus.
   

  

**Are you our new colleague?**
 We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Geir Are Bjørnsrud (geirare.bjornsrud@tietoevry.com)
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

title: Data Engineer
description:
På B3 Indes förvandlar vi data till värdefulla insikter som driver förändring och innovation. Vi skapar lösningar inom AI, Business Intelligence, Data Science och Automation för att maximera värdet av data och stärka företags konkurrenskraft. Vår styrka ligger i att kombinera passion för AI och data med en stark laganda, där vi stöttar varandra och löser utmaningar tillsammans.
   

  

**Rollen inom Data Engineering på B3:**
 Hos oss får du chansen att jobba med några av Sveriges mest spännande kunder och projekt. Vad innebär det? Jo, att du får:
   

  

* Gräva i och tillgängliggöra data som inte bara hjälper våra kunder – utan kanske till och med gör världen lite bättre.
* Göra företag mer datadrivna och smartare genom att guida dem i rätt riktning.
* Designar, modellerar och utveckla datalager som bygger på ett eller flera olika källsystem.
* Bygga och implementera avancerade lösningar – och faktiskt se dem göra skillnad!


 Här handlar det inte bara om teknik – det handlar om att modellera, tillgängliggöra och förvalta flöden av data som kan skapa verklig förändring. Vi gillar att tänka stort, experimentera och lösa kluriga problem tillsammans. Och det bästa? Du får ett team av grymma kollegor att bolla idéer med, lära dig av och ha kul ihop med!
   

  

****Det är din passion för** 
 data och analys som gör skillnaden. Utöver det ser vi gärna:**
* Har du en relevant universitetsutbildning? Toppen! Har du kanske skaffat motsvarande kunskaper genom arbetslivserfarenhet? Det funkar lika bra!
* Minst 4 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet – vi letar efter någon som har hunnit samla på sig en del erfarenhet inom området.
* Flytande svenska och engelska – eftersom båda språken används dagligen i arbetet.
* Tidigare konsultroller är ett plus! Har du jobbat som konsult tidigare? Då är det en extra merit, men inget krav.


**Men framför allt...**
 Har du djup erfarenhet av rollen som Data Engineer? Fantastiskt – det är viktigt! Men vi lägger också stor vikt vid din förmåga att se helheten, skapa användbara lösningar men framför allt att du är nyfiken. Om du dessutom har erfarenhet av flera olika moderna ramverk och utvecklarverktyg för t.ex ETL/ELT-flöden, Databaser, Data Warehouse, DataLake, Datamodellering och DevOps – är det ett stort plus.
   

  

 Vi ser även gärna att du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av att ha arbetat i en eller flera molnplattformar – Azure, AWS, GCP.
* Kanske har du också lite koll på någon av de andra vanligaste BI-verktygen (ex; Power BI eller Qlik)
* Snowflake, Databricks eller något datalager automationsverktyg (ex: TimeXtender eller Wade)
* Viss erfarenhet av att arbeta med arkitektur


**Varför välja B3 Indes?**
 💡
 **Utveckling & karriär** 
 – Väx i en entreprenörsdriven miljö där din kompetens får ta plats.
   

  

 🌿
 **Balans & välmående** 
 – Vi värnar om ditt välbefinnande med stöd för wellness och en flexibel vardag.
   

  

 🚀
 **Energi & gemenskap** 
 – Här präglas kulturen av öppenhet, nyfikenhet och en passion för att skapa något större – tillsammans.
   

  

 ❤️
 **Vi bryr oss – på riktigt** 
 – Vi engagerar oss i samhällsfrågor och samarbetar med initiativ som Suicide Zero, My Dream Now och Pink Programming för att göra skillnad även utanför arbetslivet.
   

  

**En arbetsplats som gör skillnad** 
 :
   

  

 Vi är stolta över att ha utsetts till ett av
 **Sveriges fem främsta karriärföretag 2025** 
 – en utmärkelse som speglar vår energi, nyfikenhet och vårt engagemang för att skapa en inkluderande och inspirerande arbetsplats. Här värdesätts olika perspektiv och idéer, och vi tror att det är just det som gör oss starkare.
   

  

 Hos oss får du friheten att styra över dina uppdrag, din arbetstid och din utveckling. Vi erbjuder
 **konkurrenskraftiga löner** 
 , flexibilitet att forma din vardag och en sund balans mellan jobb och fritid. Och vi vet att
 **gemenskap är minst lika viktigt som teknik** 
 – därför satsar vi på allt från konferensresor och sommarfester till sköna AW:s där vi kan släppa jobbet för en stund.
   

  

**Om B3 Consulting Group**
*B3 Consulting Group är ett expansivt konsultbolag med cirka 1000 medarbetare. Vi brinner för innovation och hjälper Sveriges ledande företag och organisationer att skapa framtidens möjligheter genom digital transformation. B3 finns på* 
 tolv orter i Sverige samt i Polen, med huvudkontor i Stockholm. Bolaget grundades 2003, är noterat på Nasdaq Stockholm Small Cap och omsatte 1 141 MSEK 2023.
   

  

*Vi är stolta över vår prisbelönta företagskultur, där olikheter, erfarenheter och gemensam energi värdesätts. Som ett etiskt och transparent bolag strävar vi efter att ha en positiv påverkan på samhället, människor och miljön. Vi är även engagerade i* 
 Women in Tech och initiativ för att stärka AI-utbildning för kvinnor. 2024 utsågs vi till Årets Employer Branding-företag, och vår HR-chef vann titeln Årets HR-chef.
   

  

**Är du redo att bli en del av ett företag där din passion för AI och data kan göra skillnad? Läs mer om oss och våra möjligheter här!**

title: Solutions Architect - Front Office (Pre-Sales)
description:
**Company Overview**
 Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
   

  

 Financial technology is a high-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
   

  

**Team Summary**
 The Forward Deployed Solution Architect (FDSA) team sits at the intersection of Arcesium's commercial and product organizations, embedded directly in helping demonstrate the value of our platform in unique client situations. This role sits specifically within the Front Office practice, covering Arcesium's cloud-native P/OMS for buy-side institutions and its fit in the broader front-to-back platform.
   

  

 We're looking for someone who brings deep front-office domain expertise and a natural ability to translate complex platform capabilities into solutions that resonate. If you thrive at the intersection of technical depth and commercial context, this role was built for you.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the solutioning layer of the sales process from initial discovery through to Proof-of-Concept delivery and deal close. You are the technical and domain anchor in every prospect engagement.
* Lead discovery with prospective clients. Engage directly with CTO, COO, Operations and front-office stakeholders (portfolio managers, heads of trading, CIO) to understand their investment workflows, data architecture, and strategic objectives.
* Design and articulate solutions, mapping Arcesium's platform capabilities to prospect problems, with a particular focus on the front-office workflow: portfolio management, order and execution management, pre-trade compliance, position keeping, and analytics.
* Deliver high-quality Proof of Concepts (PoCs). Scope, plan, and execute PoCs that demonstrate tangible, specific value quickly. Define success criteria jointly with the prospect and manage delivery to them.
* Produce compelling written proposals and materials, including solution architectures, workflow diagrams, business case narratives, and RFP responses, calibrated for both technical and business audiences.
* Present Arcesium's platform in sales conversations and demos. Articulate the technology and domain differentiation clearly and persuasively.
* Guide prospects through the technical evaluation process, including API walkthroughs, data flow discussions, integration architecture, and readiness assessments.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering. Feed prospect-derived insights back into the roadmap and ensure proposed solutions are deliverable.
* Contribute to the commercial foundation. Help develop reusable artefacts, demo environments, and solutioning playbooks that improve the team's velocity and consistency across cycles.


**What You'll Need**
* Experience in client-facing technical roles such as pre-sales, solutions consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or professional services
* Strong front-office domain knowledge across the investment management workflow: portfolio and order management (P/OMS), pre-trade compliance, IBOR/position keeping, trade capture, and the data interfaces into middle and back office. Familiarity with other Front Office systems is a strong plus.
* Broad asset class coverage: especially fixed income and OTC derivatives; comfort discussing instrument-specific workflows and data requirements at a meaningful level of depth.
* Technology fluency. Ability to engage credibly on integration architecture, API design, data flows, and cloud infrastructure.
* Commercial acumen. You understand the sales cycle, how to manage technical evaluations, and how to position platform trade-offs honestly and strategically.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills. Able to adapt for a CTO one hour and a portfolio manager the next; equally effective in written materials and live presentations.
* Strong stakeholder management. Comfortable running governance meetings, managing competing priorities across a sales process, and maintaining trust with senior external stakeholders over an extended cycle.
* Fluency in English required; Swedish is an advantage but not required.
* Valid permit to work in Sweden.


**Why Join**
* You will have genuine commercial impact. FDSAs are a decisive factor in Arcesium's ability to win complex, enterprise deals. You will see the direct line between your work and revenue.
* Deep exposure to a modern, cloud-native P/OMS in a period of rapid growth: Arcesium is scaling fast and the Front Office FDSA practice is being built now. There is real scope to shape how this function operates.
* Stockholm is Arcesium's Front Office product and engineering hub so you will work alongside the people who build the platform, not just sell it.
* Access to a global sales pipeline and a sophisticated prospect base: asset managers, hedge funds, and institutional investors across the globe.


 Arcesium's Personal Data Privacy Notice for Candidates is linked here.
   

  

**Recruiting Security**
 Emails from genuine Arcesium recruiters who are employees of the company will always come from the @arcesium.com domain. In some cases, you may also be contacted by independent search firms engaged to recruit on our behalf; emails from their employees should always come from their firm's applicable domain. We'll never ask for your banking information or any payment as part of the recruiting process. If something seems off or you're contacted by an unexpected third party, please reach out to us at careers@arcesium.com (US/UK), careers-india@arcesium.com (India) or careers-europe@arcesium.com (Portugal/Sweden).
   

  

*Arcesium is an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Försvarsmakten söker en lösningsarkitekt med inriktning C#/.net.
description:
Försvarsmaktens uppdrag är att skydda Sverige och våra värderingar. Vår profession och värdegrund präglas av viljan att stödja och hjälpa, både varandra och andra. I vår värdegrund arbetar vi efter ledorden: Öppenhet, Resultat, Ansvar. Det innebär bland annat att Försvarsmaktens medarbetare löser sina uppgifter tillsammans, vilket ställer stora krav på delaktighet, förtroende och trygghet. Inom Försvarsmakten drivs alla uppdrag med ett tydligt mål att leverera resultat i rätt tid och till förväntad kvalitet. Alla medarbetare tar ansvar genom att vara lojala, både mot varandra och mot uppdraget.
   

  

 Hos oss har du stora möjligheter att bidra till nytta och samtidigt utvecklas inom ditt kunskaps- och intresseområde.
   

  

 Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter
   

  

 Försvarsmakten är inne i en intensiv fas där olika typer av molnmiljöer håller på att implementeras och där AI är en naturlig del i arbetet. Det finns ett flertal olika applikationer/tjänster som kommer att driftsättas under de kommande åren. Försvarsmaktens förändringsresa innebär stora möjligheter till nytänkande och möjlighet till egna initiativ.
   

  

 Vi är ett team med flera olika kompetenser som systemutvecklare, kravledare, testledare och PO. I rollen som lösningsarkitekt kommer du se till att saker byggs på rätt sätt och att allt hänger ihop. Exempel på uppgifter:
   

  

* Brygga mellan verksamhet och IT
* Designa systemlösningar
* Välja teknikstack
* Säkerställa kvalitet och vidmakthållande
* Kommunicera med intressenter inklusive leverantörer


 Du kommer ingå i ett team där jobbet innebär att du tillsammans med teamet har ett stort ansvar, där du förväntas vara självgående och lösningsorienterad för att teamet tillsammans ska nå uppsatta mål.
   

  

 Vad vi erbjuder dig
   

  

 Verksamheten erbjuder stor variation och komplexitet samt stora krav på IT-säkerhet vilket innebär goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och förutsättningar för intern karriär och rörlighet. Våra anställda har ett flertal olika förmåner, bland annat:
   

  

* Kompetensutveckling utifrån ett verksamhetsbehov och dina karriärmål
* Tre timmar träning i veckan på arbetstid och du kan få träningskläder och startavgifter till vissa lopp
* Bra balans mellan arbete och fritid med flexibel arbetstid samt 28-35 semesterdagar beroende på din ålder
* Lönetillägg vid föräldraledighet och VAB samt möjlighet att växla semesterdagar mot extra pensionsavsättning


 Kvalifikationer:
   

  

* Relevant universitets-/högskoleutbildning inom IT, alternativt att du har motsvarande förvärvad erfarenhet/utbildning som Försvarsmakten bedömer som likvärdig
* Du bör ha flera års erfarenhet som utvecklare eller systemingenjör, bred teknisk kunskap (moln, nätverk, databaser, integration) samt förmågan att se helheten snarare än enskilda detaljer.
* Du behöver behärska svenska och engelska väl, både i tal och skrift
* Svensk medborgare


 Meriterande är erfarenhet av:
   

  

* Att jobba agilt (Scrum/Kanban, SAFe eller liknade)
* Azure DevOps-tjänster och produkter (eller liknande)
* Utveckling i molnmiljöer
* Programmeringskunskap i C# eller liknande
* Arbete i miljöer med mycket höga säkerhetskrav
* Integrera AI som en del i utvecklingsprocessen


 Personliga egenskaper
   

  

 Som person behöver du vara nyfiken och lösningsorienterad, ha förmåga att arbeta som en del i en grupp men också arbeta självständigt. Du har stort intresse för teknik och gillar att lära dig mer inom ditt teknikområde. Du är positiv, ser lösningar och hittar möjligheter och struktur.
   

  

 Du gillar att arbeta i en verksamhet i förändring och tillväxt och har ett högt säkerhetsmedvetande. Vår värdegrund och profession stämmer överens med dina värderingar.
   

  

 Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.
   

  

 Övrigt
   

  

 Befattningen är en civil anställning tillsvidare och inleds med 6 månader provanställning för dig som inte är anställd i Försvarsmakten sedan tidigare. Placeringsort är Stockhholm och tillträde snarast eller enligt överenskommelse. Resor förekommer i tjänsten.
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-08-30. Din ansökan skall innehålla CV samt ett personligt brev och svar på samtliga frågor som ställs. För att veta mer om rekryteringsprocessen är du välkommen att kontakta HR-generalist Stina Melin, Stina.Melin@mil.se
   

  

 ,
 **Ansökningar till denna befattning kommer endast tas emot via Försvarsmaktens webbplats.** 
 -------------------------------------------------------- Information om Försvarsmakten och det rekryterande förbandet: Försvarsmaktens telekommunikations- och informationssystemförband, FMTIS, säkerställer Försvarsmaktens förmåga att kommunicera och leda - dygnet runt, året om. Förbandet har ett samlat ansvar för Försvarsmaktens tekniska ledningssystem som stödjer militära insatser till sjöss, på land och i luften – i Sverige och utomlands. Förbandet har närmare 2000 medarbetare på mer än 32 orter runt om i landet. Läs mer på https://jobb.forsvarsmakten.se/fmtis En anställning hos oss innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Vanligtvis krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning enligt 3 kap i säkerhetsskyddslagen. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras samt att tjänstgöra utomlands. Innebörden av detta varierar beroende på typ av befattning. Till ansökan om anställning ska CV och personligt brev bifogas. Om du går vidare i anställningsprocessen ska alltid vidimerade kopior av betyg och intyg uppvisas. Samtal från externa rekryteringsföretag och säljare undanbedes.

title: Presales Engineer – HPE Infrastructure
description:
As a
 **Presales Engineer** 
 , you'll be the trusted technical advisor for both our sales teams and HPE partners.
   

  

 Working at the intersection of technology and business, you'll help partners design the right infrastructure solutions, support them throughout the sales process, and strengthen their technical capabilities through enablement and training.
   

  

 You'll play a key role in helping our partners grow their HPE business while building long-term relationships across the Nordic channel ecosystem.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Sales Support & Technical Advisory**
* Support partners throughout the entire sales cycle.
* Design and present HPE infrastructure solutions.
* Provide technical guidance, quotations, and solution proposals.
* Help partners position the right solutions for their customers.


**Partner & Customer Engagement**
* Build trusted relationships with partners and customers.
* Deliver technical workshops, demonstrations, and presentations.
* Participate in customer meetings and support strategic opportunities.
* Drive partner engagement through regular technical interactions.


**Partner Enablement**
* Train and coach partner sales and technical teams.
* Support certifications and competency development.
* Help partners understand the value of HPE solutions and how to position them successfully.
* Act as the technical expert within your specialization.


**Business Development**
* Identify new technical opportunities together with partners.
* Support Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and solution adoption.
* Translate customer challenges into scalable HPE solutions.
* Collaborate with Sales, Vendor Management and internal specialists to win new business.


**Skills & Experience**
 We're looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with commercial awareness.
   

  

 You have:
   

  

* Experience within HPE Server & Storage or Networking (Aruba / Juniper).
* A background in Presales, Systems Engineering or Technical Consulting.
* Strong technical knowledge combined with commercial understanding.
* Experience supporting partners or customers throughout the sales process.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* A consultative mindset with strong problem-solving abilities.
* Experience working within the IT channel ecosystem is an advantage.
* A passion for continuous learning and professional development.


**About Ingram Micro**
 Ingram Micro is a global leader in the IT ecosystem, connecting technology manufacturers, cloud providers, and businesses around the world. Reaching nearly
 **90% of the world's population** 
 , we play a vital role in the global technology channel by helping our partners grow through innovative solutions, deep expertise, and world-class services.
   

  

 Joining Ingram Micro means becoming part of a global organization where innovation, collaboration, and continuous development are at the heart of everything we do.

title: Senior Security Engineer - Application
description:
Beskrivning av tjänsten
   

  

**Vill du stärka säkerheten i några av Sveriges mest samhällsviktiga digitala tjänster?**
 Är du en erfaren säkerhetsspecialist som vill kombinera tekniskt djup med verklig påverkan? Hos CGI söker vi nu en
 **Senior Security Engineer - Application** 
 som vill vara med och utveckla säkerheten i ett av våra mest tekniskt avancerade affärsområden.
   

  

 I rollen arbetar du nära utvecklingsteam, arkitekter och leveransorganisationer för att bygga säkerhet från början. Du hjälper våra team att utveckla och leverera säkra lösningar i en komplex IT-miljö som omfattar moderna applikationer, containrar, molntjänster legacy-system och CI/CD-plattformar.
   

  

 Du får stor möjlighet att påverka hur säkerhetsarbetet bedrivs. Rollen omfattar automation, utveckling av integrationer och interna verktyg i exempelvis Python, användning av AI-stödda arbetssätt samt vidareutveckling av metoder och verktyg som gör säkerhet till en naturlig del av utvecklingsprocessen.
   

  

 Här får du möjlighet att påverka både tekniska vägval och hur säkerhetsarbetet utvecklas inom hela affärsenheten och inte bara granska det som andra redan har byggt.
   

  

 Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter
   

  

 Som Senior Security Engineer – Application Security får du en central roll i att utveckla säkerheten i några av Sveriges mest samhällsviktiga digitala tjänster.
   

  

 Du driver utvecklingen av moderna säkerhetsarbetssätt inom applikationssäkerhet, DevSecOps, automation och AI. Genom att utveckla integrationer, interna verktyg och effektiva säkerhetsprocesser hjälper du våra team att leverera säkra lösningar med hög kvalitet och kort ledtid.
   

  

 I dina arbetsuppgifter bland annat att:
   

  

* Vara ett tekniskt stöd till utvecklingsteam, arkitekter och leveransorganisationer i frågor som rör applikationssäkerhet.
* Genomföra och stödja hotmodellering, säkerhetsgranskningar och riskbedömningar av applikationer och lösningar.
* Utveckla och förvalta verktyg och processer för applikationssäkerhet, exempelvis SAST, DAST, SCA och säkerhetskontroller i CI/CD-pipelines.
* Stödja utvecklingsteam vid analys och hantering av identifierade sårbarheter samt ta fram åtgärdsförslag.
* Bidra till att utveckla stöd, guider och arbetssätt som hjälper utvecklingsteam att arbeta säkert.
* Identifiera möjligheter att använda AI för att effektivisera säkerhetsarbetet och stödja en säker och ansvarsfull användning av AI i utvecklingsprocessen.
* Bidra till att vidareutveckla affärsenhetens säkerhetsprogram och säkerhetskultur.
* Följa utvecklingen inom cybersäkerhet, hotbild och ny teknik samt omsätta relevanta förbättringar i verksamheten.
* Bygga långsiktig säkerhetsförmåga genom coachning, kunskapsdelning och nära samarbete med utvecklingsteamen.


 Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har:
   

  

* Flerårig erfarenhet av arbete inom applikationssäkerhet, säker systemutveckling eller DevSecOps.
* Erfarenhet av att integrera säkerhet i moderna utvecklings- och leveransprocesser.
* God kunskap om threat modeling, OWASP, vanliga sårbarheter och säker utveckling.
* Erfarenhet av säkerhetsverktyg såsom exempelvis SAST, DAST, SCA och secrets scanning samt CI/CD-plattformar och automatiserade säkerhetskontroller
* Erfarenhet av automation och utveckling av script, integrationer eller interna verktyg i Python eller liknande språk.
* Intresse för och erfarenhet av att använda AI-stödda verktyg för att effektivisera säkerhetsarbetet.
* Förmåga att omsätta säkerhetskrav till praktiska och affärsmässiga lösningar.
* God samarbetsförmåga och vana att arbeta nära utvecklare, arkitekter och andra intressenter.
* Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska.


 På grund av rollens utformning är svenskt medborgarskap ett krav.
   

  

 Meriterande:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, OpenShift eller andra containerplattformar.
* Erfarenhet av arbete i komplexa enterprise-miljöer och samhällskritiska verksamheter.


 Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen genomförs bakgrundskontroll i form av kredit- och registerkontroll. Godkänd kontroll krävs för anställning.
   

  

**Vad kan vi på CGI erbjuda dig?**
 CGIs kombination av global och lokal närvaro, med kontor på 30 orter i Sverige, ger nöjda kunder men innebär även att du som anställd alltid har ett kontor nära dig. Detta i kombination med flexibla arbetstider ger dig möjlighet till balans mellan privatliv och arbete, oavsett var i livet just du befinner dig.
   

  

 På CGI finns även stora möjligheter till interna karriärvägar där du kan välja att bli specialist inom ditt område, bredda dig inom nya områden eller ta en ledande befattning.
   

  

**Som anställd erbjuds du nedan förmåner:**
 ✅ Föräldralön: Vi betalar upp till cirka 90% av din lön under den första tiden hemma.
   

  

 ✅Aktieprogram och delägarskap: Som delägare har du möjlighet att påverka och i vårt aktieprogram matchar CGI ditt bidrag, krona för krona upp till 3% av din månadslön.
   

  

 ✅ Friskvårdsbidrag: Vi erbjuder ett årligt friskvårdsbidrag på 4000 kr.
   

  

 ✅ Trygg anställning: Våra medlemmar anställs med kollektivavtal och försäkringar.
   

  

 ✅ Pensionslösningar: Vi erbjuder attraktiva och förmånliga pensionslösningar.
   

  

 ✅ Personalbil: Personalbilen används som en privatbil men leasas av CGI.
   

  

 Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! Om du har några frågor eller funderingar kontakta gärna mig Hubertus Von Fluck som är rekryterande chef för denna roll, hubertus.von.fluck@cgi.com
   

  

 Just nu är många av oss på semester och det kan därför dröja med återkoppling på din ansökan. Vi ber om tålamod och kommer att återkomma så snart som möjligt efter semesterperioden Tack för din förståelse.
   

  

**Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.**
 Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.
   

  

 Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. Det är därför vi kallar oss CGI Partners snarare än anställda. Vi drar nytta av vår kollektiva framgång och tillsammans får vi möjlighet att aktivt forma vår företagsstrategi och inriktning.
   

  

 Ditt arbete skapar värde. Du kommer att vara med att utveckla innovativa lösningar och bygga relationer med medarbetare och kunder samtidigt som du får tillgång till globala möjligheter att skala upp dina idéer, omfamna nya möjligheter och dra nytta av gedigen bransch- och teknikexpertis.
   

  

 Du kommer att forma din karriär tillsammans med ett företag som är byggt för att växa och bestå. Du får stöd av ledare som bryr sig om din hälsa och ditt välbefinnande och ger dig möjligheter att fördjupa dina kunskaper och vidga dina vyer.
   

  

 Bli en del en av världens största leverantörer av IT- och affärskonsulttjänster.

title: SAP AMS Project Manager - Sweden
description:
**Job** 
 – Project Manager
   

  

**Technology** 
 – SAP AMS, SAP S4 Hana
   

  

**Location** 
 – Sweden
   

  

**Why Infosys**
 We invite you to be part of and be inspired by an open-minded way of working in our multinational corporation! If you want to accompany us on the way to the future of IT, you prefer innovation instead of boring repetitive project work and you want to experience growth instead of stagnation, please apply now!
   

  

 We offer exciting challenges in one of the most dynamically growing SAP consulting companies in Europe. With us you will further expand your experience and skills within a global corporate culture together with qualified and motivated colleagues. Our growth plans open up great career opportunities in a highly stimulating environment. With this growth you will get a chance to lead large global teams who work in the digital transformation journeys of our customers, mostly the DAX 30 or Fortune 1000 organizations.
   

  

 We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Project Manager – AMS to lead and oversee end-to-end application support and service delivery for our enterprise clients. In this role, you will be responsible for managing large-scale AMS programs, ensuring SLAs are met, driving continuous improvement, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality IT services. We offer you not only a learning environment with modern “on-demand” learning methods in which you can deepen your knowledge, but you will get to apply those learnings in real-time.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Relevant Service Delivery experience in Managed Services for SAP systems (S4HANA and/or ECC) functional and/or subject matter expertise can supplement for years of direct SDM experience
* Experience in a people management role, leadership
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills.
* Strong acumen to understand the business needs and ability to manage services in a very dynamic environment
* Knowledge and experience with SLA’s, OLA’s, and Contracts in insourced or outsourced environments.
* Good understanding of SAP ERP, functional and/or technical SAP application knowledge.
* Knowledge of industry trends, their impact on business strategies, and SAP’s strategy and service portfolio.
* Ideally have SAP S4HANA, IT Service Management, Project Management certifications
* Knowledge and experience with Agile and Lean process methodology preferred


**Responsibilities**
* As the one face to the customer, you will take along various service lines, giving guidance to the relevant delivery heads on the staffing needs, commercials, availabilities and the interests of the service lines even as you try to build synergies amongst them to craft efficient, lean and quality solutions for your customers.
* Oversee the delivery of SAP AMS, ensuring alignment with customer requirements.
* Maintain service quality and availability in adherence to SLAs and KPIs.
* Manage day-to-day operations for system reliability and collaborate with technical teams to resolve issues promptly.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients regarding SAP AMS services.
* Build and maintain strong relationships through regular performance reviews and feedback collection.
* Coordinate stakeholder meetings to strengthen client partnerships.
* Identify opportunities for system improvements and enhancements to optimize client business operations.
* Recommend and implement best practices to improve service delivery, reduce costs, and enhance efficiency.
* Monitor and manage team performance, providing guidance and implementing performance metrics.


**Preferred:**
* ITIL certification or experience in ITIL-based service management.
* Experience with SAP Solution Manager or other service management tools.
* PMP or other project management certifications.
* Familiarity with cloud-based SAP solutions (e.g., SAP Cloud Platform).


**Personal Skills**
 In addition to the job-related qualification of the candidates, we place great value on personality suitability and fitment:
   

  

* Pronounced ability not only to analyze but to connect the dots and think laterally
* A high degree of pro-activeness and leadership
* Passion for being customer focused and establishing long term relationships
* Intense drive for excellence and quality
* Excellent written and verbal skills both in German and English


**About Infosys**

title: Senior Software Safety Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
--------------


AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day-to-day operations. We are a Series A company backed by top-tier venture capital investors in aviation and autonomous driving. Our customers include some of the world’s largest airlines and ground handling providers. For more information, visit www.aerovect.com.


Working under the close guidance and supervision of the Head of Safety, the Senior SW Safety Engineer will execute core safety lifecycle tasks across AeroVect’s software and hardware platforms:

* **System Safety Analysis:** Perform hazard identification and risk assessments (HARA, FMEA, FTA, STPA) on the autonomous software architecture and vehicle operation concepts.
* **Requirements Derivation:** Derive, specify, and trace functional and technical safety requirements (FSRs / TSRs) for both supervised autonomy (safety driver present) and SDO unsupervised autonomy (driverless).
* **Cross-Functional Execution:** Collaborate directly with systems, software, robotics, hardware, and test teams to ensure safety requirements are integrated, testable, and verified.
* **Safety Case Support:** Assist in building safety case artifacts and verification evidence required for airport commercial deployment.

**You Will**
------------

* Conduct software hazard and safety analyses on perception, motion planning, localization, and vehicle control modules per **ISO 26262-6** and **SOTIF (ISO 21448)**.
* Execute software FMEA/FTA, freedom-from-interference (FFI) analysis, and code-level hazard evaluations.
* Derive Software Safety Requirements (SSRs) and define monitoring/fail-safe mechanisms within multi-core and Linux/RTOS software environments.
* Review safety-critical C++/Python code and robotics middleware with development teams to ensure software safety standards are met.
* Develop Safety Performance Indicators to measure safety performance over time.

**You Have**
------------

* 5+ years of hands-on safety engineering experience in autonomous vehicles, automotive (ISO 26262), aerospace (DO-178C/DO-254), or industrial safety (IEC 61508).
* Prior background working with autonomous driving systems or mobile robotics.
* Proven ability to work under the technical mentorship of a Principal Safety Engineer in a high-velocity agile engineering team.
* B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Robotics, or a related discipline.
* 5+ years of software development or SW safety experience in C++, Python, or ROS/ROS2 environments.
* Deep understanding of software safety lifecycles, ASIL decomposition for software, unit/integration test strategies, and static analysis tools.
* Hands-on experience analyzing autonomous vehicle software pipelines (perception, planning, fail-safe state machines).


Compensation Range: $160K - $180K

title: Postdoc in Human-in-the-Loop Autonomous Systems
description:
We are looking for four motivated postdocs to help design the next generation of human-in-the-loop autonomous systems at the Division of Interaction Design and Software Engineering.



You will contribute to a future in which we can rely on better robots, autonomous networks, and other smart systems – impacting domains such as healthcare, transportation, and other areas of our society. These systems are often software-intensive and we develop mechanisms to create better software for safer, more secure, and more usable systems. You will be supervised by Associate Prof. Rebekka Wohlrab, whose research focuses on human-centered software engineering and self-adaptive systems, and who has received funding from SSF, VR, and WASP. She is currently building up a team of more than 10 people. It will allow you to be part of a fun environment where you can collaborate with Doctoral students and postdocs working on similar topics!


**About us**
------------



The Department of Computer Science and Engineering, a joint department of Chalmers and the University of Gothenburg, spans the breadth of computing disciplines. Our internationally visible research, strong industry links and diverse environment create a collaborative setting where ideas grow into real impact.



At the division of Interaction Design and Software Engineering, we design smarter ways to engineer better software, and explore how people engage with digital systems, combining global research perspectives with strong collaboration with industry.


**About the research project**
------------------------------



Several projects are currently recruiting:


* SSF project (funded by the Swedish Foundation for Strategic Research) on enabling collaboration between teams of humans and autonomous systems. The goal is to design principles for effective coordination in future work environments where humans and machines interact more closely. The project may involve performing empirical studies with humans, developing run-time models that software-intensive systems can use to reason about coordination, designing methods to detect and respond to cybersecurity threats, and running experiments for evaluation. Two postdoc positions will be funded by this project.


* VR project (funded by the Swedish Research Council Vetenskapsrådet) on making self-adaptive systems aware of end users’ expectations. The goal is to design a language to describe expectations using formal modelling methods, develop methods to understand the needs of human users and to explain a system’s actions, and evaluate the contributions using simulations and physical robots.


* WASP project on Human-in-the-Loop Autonomous Systems (funded by WASP). The topic will be related to the other projects and require knowledge in software architecture, self-adaptive systems, and requirements engineering. Two postdoc positions will be funded by this project. Wallenberg AI, Autonomous Systems and Software Program (WASP) is Sweden’s largest individual research program ever, a major national initiative for strategically motivated basic research, education and faculty recruitment. The program addresses research on artificial intelligence and autonomous systems acting in collaboration with humans, adapting to their environment through sensors, information and knowledge, and forming intelligent systems-of-systems. The vision of WASP is excellent research and competence in artificial intelligence, autonomous systems and software for the benefit of Swedish society and industry. Read more: https://wasp-sweden.org/


**Who we are looking for**


#### ***The following requirements are mandatory:***


* A doctoral degree in Computer Science or an equivalent foreign degree. This eligibility requirement must be met no later than the time the employment decision is made
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
* A well-documented track record of research interests and achievements in software engineering, robotics, formal methods, human-computer interaction, or a related field
* You are highly motivated, energetic, independent, and have well-developed analytical problem-solving ability
* Your communication skills in English (written and oral) are of a high quality


You are expected to be accustomed to teaching, and to demonstrate good potential within research and education.


***The following experience will strengthen your application:***


* It is highly meritorious if the doctoral degree has been obtained within the last three years prior to the application deadline

**What you will do**
--------------------


* Perform research studies and publish in top conferences and journals
* Supervise master’s and/or PhD students to a certain extent
* Possibility to engage in teaching at undergraduate/master’s level


The position is meritorious for future roles in academia, industry, or the public sector.


**Contract terms**
------------------



The position is a temporary full-time employment for two years with the possibility of a one-year extension.



The position requires physical presence throughout the entire employment. A valid residence permit must be presented by the start date, otherwise the offer may be withdrawn.


**What we offer**
-----------------


* As a postdoc at Chalmers, you are an employee and enjoy all employee benefits. Read more about working at Chalmers and our benefits for employees.
* A dynamic and inspiring working environment in the coastal city of Gothenburg.
* Read more about Sweden’s generous parental leave, subsidized day care, free schools, healthcare etc at Move To Gothenburg.


Chalmers is dedicated to improving gender balance and actively works with equality projects, such as the GENIE Initiative for gender equality and excellence. We celebrate diversity and consider equality and inclusion as fundamental aspects of all our activities.



If Swedish is not your native language, Chalmers offers Swedish courses to help you settle in.


**Application procedure**
-------------------------


*The application should be written in English be attached as PDF-files, as below. Maximum size for each file is 40 MB. Please note that the system does not support Zip files.*


#### **CV**


* A comprehensive CV, including a complete list of publications.
* Details of previous teaching and pedagogical experience.

#### **Personal letter**


* A brief introduction about yourself.
* A summary of your previous research fields and key research outcomes.
* An outline of your future goals and research focus.


Use the button at the foot of the page to reach the application form.  

  

A background check may be conducted as part of the application process.  

  

**Please note:** The applicant is responsible for ensuring that the application is complete. Incomplete applications and applications sent by email will not be considered. Contact details to references will be requested after the interview.


**We welcome your application no later than August 31**


#### **For questions, please contact:**


*Rebekka Wohlrab*  

*Associate Professor*  

*wohlrab@chalmers.se*


### **We look forward to your application!**


*\*\*\* Chalmers declines to consider all offers of further announcement publishing or other types of support for the recruiting process in connection with this position.* \*\*\*


*Chalmers University of Technology in Gothenburg conducts research and education in technology and natural sciences at a high international level. The university has 3100 employees and 10,000 students, and offers education in engineering, science, shipping and architecture. With scientific excellence as a basis, Chalmers promotes knowledge and technical solutions for a sustainable world. Through global commitment and entrepreneurship, we foster an innovative spirit, in close collaboration with wider society.*  

*Chalmers was founded in 1829 and has the same motto today as it did then: Avancez – forward.*
